| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

# Did you know?

The QR codes on our ballots were supposed to be phased out by July, but that deadline is likely to be missed. While you verify your vote by reading the printed text, the scanner actually ignores those names and tallies your vote using a hidden numbered system inside the QR code. Transitioning to text-only scanning is crucial because it ensures the machine is reading exactly what you see, closing the gap between voter intent and the final count.

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. | | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn’t a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal — the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God’s grace.**

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**“God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.”**_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.
---
[](https://trk.conservativereboot.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9ojkx&__onlt=h)
---

Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

---
In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans...

...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — _**it’s the message of FAITH!**_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. _And it’s happening._

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we’re witnessing is not just growth —**it’s revival.**

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families.

We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message.

You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie.

**But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up.**

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, _“We’re not backing down.”_

This is what Charlie prayed for.

I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too.

None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, **_so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith._**

Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God.

He’s a firefighter, a union president, a snowplow driver, and a lifelong advocate for workers. He’s spent his career running toward danger to protect his neighbors and standing shoulder to shoulder with working families to make sure they get a fair deal. Bob understands the urgency of lowering costs because he’s lived the pressure of long hours, multiple jobs, and paychecks that need to stretch further than they should. That perspective is exactly what Congress needs more of. This race will help determine whether we can build a House majority that actually delivers for everyday Americans – or whether the status quo continues to leave too many people behind. | [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/5e5f0bdb-88bf-4598-b9f6-e1e9dfff8679?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Emily Jones -- a [candidate for the Alabama State Board of Education](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/3e9c6b15-52b6-470b-a2d2-9e39ee34e730?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), District 8, and a vocal parental rights advocate -- argues that even in one of America's most conservative states, bureaucratic maneuvers can undermine hard-won parental protections. She warns that if such subversion succeeds in Alabama, which boasts a Republican supermajority and some of the nation's strongest parental rights laws, then no state can be considered a reliable refuge for families seeking to shield their children from ideological overreach in education and mental health.

Alabama's laws include bans on gender-transition procedures for minors, curriculum transparency requirements, legal definitions of male and female, protections for girls' sports, and a distinctive mandate requiring prior parental opt-in before schools provide any mental health services -- including discussions of suicide, bullying, or other sensitive psychological topics. These measures reflect a deliberate effort to prioritize parental authority over state or school intervention in children's upbringing, mental health, and physical well-being.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.Vha8d88HyeKfCZLli4txu4tPGnFqlmilX6mtt7g_cSg?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=186279096)
The central controversy revolves around a new parental consent law effective October 1, 2025. It requires explicit written parental permission for schools to offer mental health-related services or discussions. However, Jones accuses the Alabama State Department of Education (ALSDE) of creating a deliberate "footnote loophole" in the required opt-in forms. This footnote exempts "instruction, advisement, and occasional interventions" from the opt-in requirements, claiming these are routine duties of school counselors and educators.

According to Jones, this interpretation guts the statute's intent. It potentially allows school personnel -- who are not licensed physicians or therapists -- to engage minors in psychologically significant conversations about trauma, suicidal ideation, bullying, or gender identity without any parental notification or consent. Jones describes this as a calculated bypass: "Agencies should not be allowed to bury statutes in footnotes, reinterpret laws by memo, or use therapeutic language to bypass parental authority. These are not technical disagreements.

"She frames the issue as part of a larger pattern where schools blur the line between education and health care, often embedding DEI-driven or "gender ideology" content into counseling frameworks. For instance, Alabama's guidance encourages students to "identify individual differences" and "describe and respect differences among individuals" -- language the author sees as a vehicle for introducing controversial values without oversight.

Jones invokes constitutional backing, noting that the U.S. Supreme Court has repeatedly affirmed parents' fundamental right to direct the upbringing of their children. She specifically references the decision in Mahmoud v. Taylor, which held that schools imposing ideologically loaded services or content without notice or opt-out options burden parental rights and religious liberty. Such end-runs around consent laws, she argues, invite serious legal and civil rights challenges.

Her critique extends nationwide, asserting that similar tactics are spreading. Examples include:

Illinois mandating mental health screenings without opt-in provisions,

Mississippi rolling out a statewide youth wellness platform,

Tennessee placing mental health clinicians in every public school with substantial funding,

Ohio expanding school-based health centers that integrate mental health treatment on campus.

These initiatives, in her view, normalize "state-sponsored emotional profiling" and erode the boundary between education and medical/psychological intervention. Parents, she insists, hold the primary authority over decisions affecting their children's mental and physical health -- not government agencies or school bureaucrats.
She contrasts this with the COVID-era playbook, where mandates were imposed first and justifications provided later. She sees the current approach as "the same playbook, new label," repackaged under terms like "social-emotional learning" or "student wellness.

Jones delivers a stark warning: "If this can happen in Alabama -- arguably the most pro-parental-rights state in the country -- then no state is safe." Parents who relocated from blue states to red ones like Alabama did so to escape ideological interference, but "paperwork tricks" and administrative reinterpretations threaten to make the "red-state refuge" a myth. Strong laws alone are insufficient; rigorous enforcement is essential. She calls for legal pushback against these "unconstitutional" maneuvers and urges parents to demand both robust legislation and accountability from education agencies.

* * *

---
| | Friend,
---
| | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn’t a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal — the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God’s grace.**

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**“God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.”**_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.
---
[](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9okf0&__onlt=h)
---
When you read it, you will hear Charlie’s voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family.

Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

**[To claim your copy of this life-changing book, simply make a generous gift in any amount to Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9okf0&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9okf0&__onlt=h)
---
In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans...

...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — _**it’s the message of FAITH!**_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

See, I get why some folks voted for Trump.

He promised to attack a broken system. And it’s a ripe target.
Even before Trump came on the scene, America had one of the most corrupt political systems in the Western world.

It’s been running on corporate money, secret money, billionaire money.

And it’s worse than ever now.
Citizens United was the worst court decision in modern American history.

When members of Congress aren’t begging for money from Washington lobbyists, they’re trying to dodge getting carpet-bombed by super PACs.

Senators get threatened with millions of dollars of attack ads over the votes they take.
And see, that is why things don’t work for ordinary people.

It’s because the people’s elected representatives don’t represent the people. They represent the big donors!

That corruption is why they defunded nursing homes to cut taxes for the rich.
Corruption is why you pay a fortune for prescriptions.

Corruption is why your insurance claim keeps getting denied.

Corruption is why hedge funds get to buy up all the houses in your neighborhood, and then your corporate landlord ignores your calls during a gas leak.

Corruption is why that ambulance costs $3,000 after you just had to get your choking toddler to the hospital.
Yes, the system really is rigged.

But Trump’s not unrigging it. He’s re-rigging it for himself!

He’s a crook and a con man, and he wants to be a king.

You can’t claim to be for ordinary men and women when you defund their hospitals and nursing homes.
You can’t claim to be for ordinary men and women when you defund school lunch programs to help feed little boys and little girls whose hardworking parents are struggling to fill the fridge.

You can’t claim to be for ordinary men and women when you do these things so you can cut taxes for the richest people in the country while you and your family business rake in massive sums from around the world.
Donald Trump’s second term has already done unfathomable damage to our country and the lives of millions of people.

And the people are beginning to see it. But only by regaining Congressional power can we stop him.

Really.
The upcoming 2026 midterms are our last chance to restore checks and balances.

And my Senate race in Georgia is the single most critical contest: I’m the only Democratic Senator up for reelection in 2026 in a state Trump carried in 2024.
So if you’re outraged by what’s happening to our country — and you’re ready to fight for the future of this Republic — please don’t wait until 2028: Split a donation of $5 between Jacky Rosen's campaign and my reelection campaign in Georgia right now to help us reach our critical end-of-month goal.

The average online donation to our campaign is around $30.

Please give what you can.

All that matters is that lots and lots of people are contributing what they can to power our grassroots campaign before the end of the year.

Jon Ossoff

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children. By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: “God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.” His book, Stop, in the Name of God is the fruit of that conviction. When you read it, you will hear Charlie’s voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family. Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive... A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us. I believe you will find this book inspiring. Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life. In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans... ...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — it’s the message of FAITH! In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God. Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. And it’s happening. After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country. What we’re witnessing is not just growth —it’s revival. At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old. We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families. We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message. You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie. But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up. All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, “We’re not backing down.” This is what Charlie prayed for. I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too. None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith. Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God. I’ll personally ensure your copy is sent to you as soon as possible. Thank you in advance for carrying on Charlie’s mission and supporting his legacy. For Charlie, Justin Streiff Chief Operating Officer Turning Point USA P.S. When you read Stop, in the Name of God, you will discover what Charlie found in the Sabbath: a holy rest that steadies the heart, renews the soul, and gives strength for the road ahead. ** 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044 / / DISCLOSURE OF MATERIAL CONNECTION: Assume the sender of this email maintains an affiliate partnership or other material tie with entities or individuals referenced herein and may earn compensation from purchases made via linked websites. Good morning, friend.
I'm an early riser, always have been. If the sun's up, I'm up, ready to dive into my day. In these early days of 2026, I’ve been sitting with a strong cup of coffee and reflecting—not just on the challenges of the past year, but on how difficult this year has already been. The beginning of 2026 has brought continued violence, heartbreak, and uncertainty for so many communities, much of it fueled by the Trump administration’s reckless agenda and its deliberate efforts to sow fear and division.
2025 was already a deeply challenging year for countless families. The administration’s economic “policies,” attacks on Medicaid and SNAP benefits, and ongoing threats to basic dignity and safety put so many people in impossible positions—and unfortunately, those harms have only continued into this year.
**In moments like these, leadership matters. That’s why I’m ready to step forward and serve as New Mexico’s next governor. At a moment when Washington is turning its back on working families, governors are often the last line of defense, protecting our rights, our healthcare, and our economic security. I’m running to make sure New Mexico has a governor who will always show up and fight for a better, more affordable future for all New Mexican families.**

When reform actually threatens power, the masks come off.Here’s what that looked like. | WYOMING - THE SWAMP IS IN PANIC MODE The Wyoming Freedom Caucus isn’t just influencing policy. They control the State House — and that fact has clearly rattled the political class. A recent exposed - get this - a liberal Republican state senator attending a meeting hosted by Democrats for the express purpose of attacking the Wyoming Freedom Caucus and the State Freedom Caucus Network. Why the panic?Because the Wyoming Freedom Caucus passed a tax cut last year. Because they advanced election integrity reforms that made it harder for Democrats to infiltrate Republican primaries. And because they are now governing as a unified, disciplined bloc instead of playing the usual go-along-to-get-along game. In an unintended moment of honesty, one consultant described the WY Freedom Caucus as “a large, organized and orchestrated voting bloc” that now controls the Wyoming House — and acknowledged its connection to the State Freedom Caucus Network.That wasn’t an attack. LinkedIn removed the post as “hateful speech.” Rather than comply or beg for reinstatement, we deleted our account outright. Only after the story got , LinkedIn claimed that removing the post was an “error” — . At the same time, Freedom Caucus lawmakers in multiple states are facing direct harassment. Bob Phalen, received a similar message. Both incidents went national after being shared by Libs of TikTok. Listen to the voicemails and . Different states. Same response. When lawmakers touch the money or enforce the law, the attacks turn personal.BOTTOM LINE: Censorship and intimidation aren’t signs of weakness. Alex Kolodin asked three Democrat lobbyists a basic question that should unite every functioning democracy: Should you have to be a citizen in order to vote in Arizona elections? None of them could answer “yes.” No trick wording. No procedural dodge. Just silence, deflection, and discomfort — all on camera. It was a rare moment of clarity, not because of what was said, but because of what wasn’t. This is why election integrity fights matter. Peter,

I'm writing to you today with an urgent update about a troubling trend we've uncovered.

**High schoolers in Minneapolis have joined the anti-ICE riots!**

Defending Education has uncovered training documents and group chats suggesting these student protests are being coordinated by the activist group Sunrise Movement, its members, and aligned unions.

Sunrise Movement sponsors K-12 school clubs and has received funding from donor organizations such as the Ford Foundation, the Tides Foundation, and the Windward Fund. It is even listed as a partner with the American Federation of Teachers' (AFT) Climate Justice campaign.

The materials we uncovered show that students are being offered walkout guides, "day of action" strategies, and training on how to respond to federal agents on school property.

Defending Education has uncovered training documents and group chats suggesting these student protests are being coordinated by the activist group Sunrise Movement, its members, and aligned unions. It is even listed as a partner with the American Federation of Teachers' (AFT) Climate Justice campaign. The materials we uncovered show that students are being offered walkout guides, "day of action" strategies, and training on how to respond to federal agents on school property. Schools are meant to be safe places for learning, not recruiting grounds for political activism. Defending Education is working to restore schools at all levels from activists imposing harmful agendas. These Minneapolis high school protests didn't appear out of nowhere. It's the result of years of political activism being embedded in schools. We're not talking about occasional student expression -- we're talking about organized efforts to pull kids out of class, equip them with activist tactics, and advance a political agenda without parental consent or oversight. # Standing Strong for Election Integrity
---
| | Dear Friend and Patriot,
I hope this email finds you and your family well. I'm truly grateful for the incredible support we're seeing across Michigan as we build toward the March endorsement convention. It's an honor to earn the support of grassroots Republicans like you who are fighting for our shared America First values.
**Election integrity remains a top priority for all Michiganders** —and that's why I recorded a short message addressing Secretary Benson's renewed refusal to cooperate with the Trump administration's lawful request for voter data under the Help America Vote Act (HAVA). **This federal law requires transparency to keep our voter rolls accurate and secure, yet she's blocking access to basic information needed for fair elections**. [Click on the video below to watch my message to Benson](https://kevinformi.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=39782b0ca6b504d2faad7a196&id=10548379e2&e=4b10910eed):
[](https://kevinformi.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=39782b0ca6b504d2faad7a196&id=a1cd9314e0&e=4b10910eed)
This isn't about politics — **it's about accountability and ensuring every legal vote counts**. Michigan voters deserve confidence in our system.
As Michigan’s next Attorney General, **I'll demand full compliance with HAVA and fight relentlessly for secure, transparent elections that all Michiganders can trust**. We can't have officials standing in the way of what’s right — Michigan families deserve leadership that puts the law and citizens first.
---
| | **Let’s Keep Winning for Michigan Families!**
Thank you for standing with me as we fight to restore election integrity. Together, we'll make Michigan safe, affordable, normal, and red again. I'm honored to earn your support – let's secure this nomination and win big.
Very truly yours,Kevin Kijewski
Republican Candidate for Michigan Attorney General

**Its nearly decision time...**

**Harris County faces a simple choice:** we keep the waste, the out-of-control taxes and the annual deficits —or we choose a leader who will dismantle and rebuild a _fool-proof_ system that will benefit all Houstonians for many generations to come.
I’m Warren Howell, Candidate for Harris County Judge and I’ve spent my life building successful businesses, balancing budgets, and delivering results in the real world.

Hi Peter,

We are enormously proud to announce our latest endorsement for the 2026 cycle: Joanna Whaley, candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives - District 2.

**While we try to keep these endorsement announcement emails joyful and celebratory, especially since Whaley is truly an extraordinary person and candidate, we want to make sure you understand the dynamics of this race and why it’s so important that we rush support to Joanna today. We’ll explain below...**
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/124345932/598326837/-1423737804?refcode=EM_F_260130Whaley_N_CD_90DO_17_G_N_P1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjRkY2Y3NzQzLWVhZmQtZjAxMS04MzJmLTAwMGQzYTFmMGU0YyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=7xGPWpImSVMk5sFmT2UryDrLKp_00PUrWCuZfy5n8JI=)
---
Joanna has shared with us that she’s experiencing harassment and death threats ever since she launched her campaign. The situation has become so intense that Joanna has made a practice of hiring armed security when she attends campaign events. She updated that **her team has budgeted at least $500 per month _just for security_** , depending on the threats and types of events she is attending.

The dynamics: If elected, Joanna will be the first openly transgender woman in the Michigan state house. While this district leans liberal, Joanna knows her candidacy is not well-received by everyone. In fact, one of her primary opponents voiced that, "this area won't elect a transgender woman,” and more recently started calling her “** __a he/she__** ” in front of voters.

If this is the behavior of her _Democratic opponent_ – a man who is currently in public office, we can only imagine the harassment she has been experiencing from the general public. At Her Bold Move, we believe no one should endure harassment and threats just for running for political office.

This is, of course, a way of intimidating formidable candidates out of running for office. We know Joanna can win this race – but, due to her security costs and other safety considerations she’s had to make along the way, she will have a more expensive campaign than her white, cis, male counterparts.

Getting here wasn't easy, Peter
Peter: **[In a moment, I'm going to ask you to make a split donation of $10 between Heartland Patriots and my campaign.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/99211?refcode=em20260130-10005&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=1&akid=10005%2E614464%2ECRM5Ni)** But first, will you let me explain who I am, why I'm in this race, and the difference your donation will make?
As the daughter of a Pueblo woman, I was taught the value of hard work from a very young age.
My mother was born and raised in a train boxcar, where the Laguna people built a community far from their home. She proudly served in the U.S. Navy, raised four kids as a military wife, and devoted more than two decades to Indian education at the Bureau of Indian Affairs.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/99211?refcode=em20260130-10005&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=10005%2E614464%2ECRM5Ni)
I am blessed to come from generations of resilient and fierce Pueblo women – **and I am the person, mother, and leader I am today because of them.** _But getting here wasn't easy, Peter, and the hard work and resilience I learned proved essential._
Like many New Mexicans, I know what it’s like to struggle. I was a single mom living paycheck to paycheck, relying on government programs like SNAP, WIC, and Medicaid to help keep my child fed and healthy. **Every day, as hard as it was, I had to get back up and keep going.**
But my struggle made me fierce. It fortified my resolve to build a brighter future – not only for my child, _but for every family dreaming of and fighting for a better life._
That's why I decided to run for office in 2018. _And I won._ I became one of the first Native American women elected to Congress, and in 2021, the first Native American cabinet secretary in U.S. history. **Now, I'm running to be the next governor of New Mexico to help move our state toward a future where everyone can thrive.**
**Every step of my journey has been possible because people like you believed in me, Peter. So please:[Can I count on you to chip in $10 or more right now to be split between Heartland Patriots and my campaign help me win, keep New Mexico blue and deliver progress for working families?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/99211?refcode=em20260130-10005&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=3&akid=10005%2E614464%2ECRM5Ni)**

_**EXHIBIT 1 - JOINT FUNDRAISING NOTICE **_

Team Nunn ("JFC") is a joint fundraising committee composed of Iowans for Zach Nunn ("Campaign"), Call to Service PAC ("LPAC") and NRCC (each, a "Committee," and, collectively, the "Committees"). Any contribution to the JFC permissible under the Federal Election Campaign Act, as amended ("FECA"), from contributors who have not exceeded their applicable federal contribution limits, shall be allocated among the Committees pursuant to FECA and the formula set forth in this Notice.

_**Contributions Made by an Individual or Federal Non-Multicandidate Political Committee:**_
Individuals or federal non-multicandidate PACs may contribute up to $322,100. Such contributions shall be allocated in the following order:
1\. Campaign shall receive any contribution not exceeding $7,000, designating up to $3,500 to the primary election and up to $3,500 to the general election, provided such limits apply.
2\. LPAC shall receive any contribution not exceeding $5,000 annually.
3\. NRCC shall receive for its general account any contribution not exceeding $44,300 annually.

| | , I want to share something a little different with you today. **I recently sat down for a long-form conversation on a podcast, and it gave me the chance to talk at length about why I’m running for Texas Attorney General, what I believe, and what’s at stake for Texas in 2026.** These conversations matter to me. They’re not sound bites or talking points. They’re an opportunity to explain my values, my record, and why I believe the Attorney General’s office must once again serve the people instead of powerful interests. We talked about defending the Constitution, standing up to corruption, protecting the vulnerable, and why I believe Texans are ready to turn the page on cruelty and chaos in state government. If you have a few minutes, I hope you’ll give it a listen and share it with someone who wants to understand what this campaign is really about. **Listen to the podcast here:**
[Mission: Texas Podcast w/ guest Joe Jaworski](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=28701a6809&e=5d8d80652b) Campaigns are built one conversation at a time, and your help spreading the word makes a real difference. Thank you for being part of this fight and for standing with me. Onward!

**

name: Jeff Allen, Campaign Manager, Team Cooper for NC
subject: The days pass quickly.
body:
We’re running out of time.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/2365?source=&t=1&akid=444%2E124072%2EDqxK96)
Peter — The midterm elections might feel far away, but from all my years of experience in close races like this one, I can tell you this: The days pass quickly. There is _never_ as much time as it seems — for sharing our candidate’s message, for connecting with undecided voters, for encouraging our supporters to cast their ballots. **Roy Cooper is the candidate who can win, but we can’t waste a moment. For campaigns like ours, there can be no off days.** Making the most of the time we do have (as of today, there are just 277 days left to Election Day) requires having the resources to fully fund our aggressive campaign plans. **[Our finance team crafts our budgets down to the last cent. This month, our online fundraising goal is $500,000, and with just hours left in January, we haven’t yet hit our target. Could you give $25 or more right away to close the gap?](https://act.roycooper.com/go/5208?t=7&akid=444%2E124072%2EDqxK96)** Look, our race is rated a toss-up and expected to become the most expensive U.S. Senate race in history. Recent polling shows our opponent gaining ground by the day. But if we don’t win here, Democrats have _no path_ to taking back the Senate and stopping the chaos of this administration. **[This is the most important Senate seat on the map, and it’s up to all of us to play our part in making this campaign a success. Please donate whatever’s right for you to join Roy in the fight.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/5209?t=8&akid=444%2E124072%2EDqxK96)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/5210?t=9&akid=444%2E124072%2EDqxK96)

Jeff Allen
Campaign Manager
Roy Cooper for North Carolina
* * *
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

name: Justin Streiff, Turning Point USA
subject: Charlie’s final book wasn’t about politics...
body:
[unsubscribe](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?xul=o5pvyewrzrxe8xiau9slbgewgz7kz595iyn2e2yvna0noy9u27fk37mj2pl7cqu4acgg9fbo5byb0i9yc3vz5evfmr0eu1u1n8ooc5d&__stmp=t9oo60&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh)
Please read the message below from our sponsor.
* * *
| | | [](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9oo60&__onlt=h)
---
| | Friend,
---
| | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn’t a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal — the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God’s grace.**

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**“God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.”**_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.
---
[](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9oo60&__onlt=h)
---
When you read it, you will hear Charlie’s voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family.

Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

**[To claim your copy of this life-changing book, simply make a generous gift in any amount to Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9oo60&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9oo60&__onlt=h)
---
In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans...

...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — _**it’s the message of FAITH!**_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. _And it’s happening._

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we’re witnessing is not just growth —**it’s revival.**

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families.

We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message.

You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie.

**But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up.**

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, _“We’re not backing down.”_

This is what Charlie prayed for.

I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too.

None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, **_so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith._**

Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God.

**[To claim your copy of Charlie’s final book, simply make a gift, in any amount, to support Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9oo60&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9oo60&__onlt=h)
---
I’ll personally ensure your copy is sent to you as soon as possible.

Thank you in advance for carrying on Charlie’s mission and supporting his legacy.
---
**For Charlie,**

**Justin Streiff**
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point USA

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. And it’s happening. After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country. What we’re witnessing is not just growth —it’s revival. At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old. We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families. We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message. You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie. But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up. All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, “We’re not backing down.” This is what Charlie prayed for. I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too. None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith. Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God. I’ll personally ensure your copy is sent to you as soon as possible. Thank you in advance for carrying on Charlie’s mission and supporting his legacy. For Charlie, Justin Streiff Chief Operating Officer Turning Point USA P.S. body:
An inside look into our 2026 legislative agenda — and how we're continuing to deliver for Marylanders.
---
| | | | | [](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2FPages%2Fhome.aspx/1/0100019c0f8a784b-7aba9b74-b86b-4564-8e3b-dc8418420b15-000000/mf9D3Eb9oLE1AJ6qoyxpgWNYlmf2dFmIGXR06IbPuKA=442)
---
| | [](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fv=-olLrrWYubQ/1/0100019c0f8a784b-7aba9b74-b86b-4564-8e3b-dc8418420b15-000000/qC08jieLmxuRQ-AQ9tj588DV-NusOR0V61J6tNpTVzI=442)
---
Maryland,
This year, our agenda is focused on the kitchen table issues. In partnership with the General Assembly, we’ll:
⬇️ Work to [lower energy bills](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress%2Fpages%2FGovernor-Moore-Announces-the-Lower-Bills-and-Local-Power-Act-to-Combat-Rising-Utility-Costs-and-Deploy-Affordable-Local-Ene.aspx/1/0100019c0f8a784b-7aba9b74-b86b-4564-8e3b-dc8418420b15-000000/4ip7AK8VzZZgLj6ndBRzzpKh7c1D0Q31emmCRP9lfHg=442) and [housing costs](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress%2Fpages%2FGovernor-Moore-Announces-Housing-Growth-and-Affordability-Agenda-for-2026-Legislative-Session.aspx/1/0100019c0f8a784b-7aba9b74-b86b-4564-8e3b-dc8418420b15-000000/MyPBMy0EsaiM7g_kjpjERBXpvsxTUPnLTxC3hSjHh14=442),
🏬 Bring more [businesses](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress%2Fpages%2FSphere-Entertainment,-The-State-Of-Maryland,-Prince-George%2527s-County,-And-Peterson-Companies-Announce-Intent-To-Develop-A-Sp.aspx/1/0100019c0f8a784b-7aba9b74-b86b-4564-8e3b-dc8418420b15-000000/YcS3eD5vWX1x7RqEczaqqXHabAb_eCr4BmlWMoqdZzo=442) to Maryland,
💼 Connect people with [good-paying jobs](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress%2Fpages%2FGovernor-Moore-Launches-%25245-Million-Incentive-Program-to-Expand-Maryland%25E2%2580%2599s-Apprenticeship-Workforce.aspx/1/0100019c0f8a784b-7aba9b74-b86b-4564-8e3b-dc8418420b15-000000/hsw8wP2diYLKU_LvL_w9CQFxyy_WiJlgcdK4s2OX85U=442),
🎓 [Invest in public education and public safety](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress%2Fpages%2FGovernor-Moore-Kicks-Off-2026-Legislative-Session-with-Ambitious-Agenda-to-Invest-in-Education,-Enhance-Public-Safety,-and-.aspx/1/0100019c0f8a784b-7aba9b74-b86b-4564-8e3b-dc8418420b15-000000/MlqRWmWjOLWZSxaKFvFuvPB7kQlSaiq8Q0Arp4LkHXQ=442), and
⚕️ [Protect Marylanders' health](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress%2Fpages%2FGovernor-Moore-Announces-%2524164-Million-in-Hospital-Surge-Funding-to-Support-Access-to-Care-Amid-High-Rates-of-Respiratory-Il.aspx/1/0100019c0f8a784b-7aba9b74-b86b-4564-8e3b-dc8418420b15-000000/pz5y1jfwrQHKsEC08ck8RAgevE4FaS2E2wrUvWMTH8o=442).
And for the fourth year in a row, I've introduced a [balanced state budget](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fgovernor.maryland.gov%2Fnews%2Fpress%2Fpages%2FGovernor-Moore-Releases-Fiscal-Year-2027-Proposed-Budget.aspx/1/0100019c0f8a784b-7aba9b74-b86b-4564-8e3b-dc8418420b15-000000/K526wvFhVVeHXuUw68JS98bq7B94gPdXnHs6Z0dPNDU=442), making responsible adjustments to our programs, without raising taxes.
As the federal government attacks our people, we will continue to support them. We’re living through a moment of heightened political tension, and people feel the stakes every day in their communities, at the workplace, and around their kitchen tables.
But I know that there's a better way to govern than politics as usual. A way that brings people together and treats urgency as a responsibility.
In Maryland, we will keep moving forward. Together.
_**[Watch the full agenda explainer here.](https://links-1.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fv=-olLrrWYubQ/2/0100019c0f8a784b-7aba9b74-b86b-4564-8e3b-dc8418420b15-000000/Ug16x9-Bn_QCRpdphNKrQFoDBizUwJyy28_pWJSM4iY=442)**_
Your Governor,
Wes Moore

# **BREAKING: Don Lemon Arrested for Church Protest**
Former CNN anchor Don Lemon, 59, **[was arrested in Los Angeles on Friday](https://substack.com/redirect/51961c5f-5ae9-4337-ba87-0b9f84aa8dea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and taken into federal custody after joining pro-immigration protesters who stormed Cities Church in St. Paul, Minnesota on January 18. He has been charged with conspiracy to deprive rights and violating the FACE Act, which bans interfering with religious services by force.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/51961c5f-5ae9-4337-ba87-0b9f84aa8dea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This image is a symbolic recreation, not a photograph
* **Defense Claims First Amendment Protection** \- Lemon's attorney Abbe Lowell defended the church storming as "constitutionally protected" journalism, arguing that "the First Amendment exists to protect journalists whose role it is to shine light on the truth." During the incident, Lemon was filmed arguing with a church pastor who called his behavior "shameless," with Lemon insisting his actions were covered by freedom of speech and assembly.
* **Church Targeted Because of Pastor 's ICE Role** \- Protesters specifically targeted the church because one of its pastors, David Easterwood, also serves as the acting director of the St. Paul ICE field office. Protest organizer Nekima Levy Armstrong, who was also later arrested, told Lemon they chose to overwhelm the Sunday service because the church was "harboring someone who is commanding ICE agents to terrorize our communities."

# Trump responds to new footage of Alex Pretti assaulting law enforcement weeks before shooting
President Donald Trump **[commented that Alex Pretti's "stock has gone way down" ](https://substack.com/redirect/5fc9ddf5-6e88-427f-9f8b-0e1bcf111c8a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**after video from January 13 showed Pretti spitting at federal immigration officers and violently kicking the taillight off their government SUV during an anti-immigration enforcement protest in Minneapolis.
## [Watch:](https://substack.com/redirect/b1fcef41-a6ba-4991-b23c-a75330a8baea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/b1fcef41-a6ba-4991-b23c-a75330a8baea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Click To Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/b1fcef41-a6ba-4991-b23c-a75330a8baea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Fatal Shooting During Arrest** \- Pretti, a 37-year-old ICU nurse, was fatally shot 11 days later on January 24 during a struggle with Border Patrol agents who had pulled a loaded Sig Sauer pistol from his waistband. DHS investigators believe an errant round from Pretti's own weapon may have prompted agents to fire at least 10 shots at him while he was pinned to the ground.

* **Federal Response to Unrest** \- The two Border Patrol agents involved in the shooting have been placed on administrative leave, and Trump sent border czar Tom Homan to Minnesota to de-escalate tensions following the deaths of Pretti and fellow protester Renee Good on January 7.

# **Chinese Communist Party-linked funding discovered behind protest network**
Neville Roy Singham, a former U.S. tech mogul who sold his IT consulting company for $785 million in 2017 and moved to Shanghai, **[has allegedly funneled over $250 million to dark money organizations](https://substack.com/redirect/7d52790c-b398-480b-86ed-211886af3b02?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** financing anti-ICE protests in Minneapolis and across the U.S., including the Party for Socialism and Liberation and The People's Forum.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7d52790c-b398-480b-86ed-211886af3b02?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Congressional Investigations and Legal Barriers** \- Multiple congressional committees have launched investigations into Singham's network, but his residence in China shields him from U.S. subpoenas and enforcement. Lawmakers are concerned that Singham is not registered under the Foreign Agents Registration Act (FARA) despite his alleged ties to CCP propaganda efforts and funding of organizations that "oppose U.S. interests and support U.S. adversaries."
**Organized Protest Network** \- Former federal prosecutors confirm that the Minneapolis demonstrations are supported by organized groups collaborating to mobilize agitators, with evidence suggesting some protesters are being paid to attend. Singham's funding flows through nonprofit organizations with minimal reporting requirements, making it difficult to trace the money and hold him accountable despite FBI investigations dating back to 1974.

# **Kristi Noem responds to call for her resignation**
DHS Secretary Kristi Noem said "radicals" are targeting her as she **[faces mounting pressure to resign or be fired](https://substack.com/redirect/479a0ed1-0a44-4b09-ac50-c9902ebe4a15?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** from prominent Democrats including Sen. John Fetterman, California Gov. Gavin Newsom, and House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries, as well as some Republicans like Sens. Thom Tillis and Lisa Murkowski, following the fatal shootings of Alex Pretti and Renee Good during immigration enforcement operations in Minnesota.
## [Watch:](https://substack.com/redirect/4db07bd8-cf0c-48fe-86fb-5dac92c8a74a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/4db07bd8-cf0c-48fe-86fb-5dac92c8a74a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Trump Stands Behind Noem** \- President Trump has maintained he has no plans to ask Noem to step down, telling reporters she is doing a "very good job" at securing the border. Noem cited newly released video showing Pretti kicking and spitting at federal agents days before his death as evidence of the hostility officers face, stating that agents have been attacked during operations and even at their hotels while off duty.

* **Leadership Changes and Blame** \- Trump replaced Border Patrol commander Greg Bovino with border czar Tom Homan in Minnesota this week. Noem accused Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz and Minneapolis Mayor Jacob Frey of inflaming tensions and refusing to cooperate with federal immigration enforcement, urging them to "change their rhetoric" and work with DHS to address dangerous criminals in their state.

# **California university hit with Title IX violation for allowing male volleyball player to dominate females**
The U.S. Department of Education's Office for Civil Rights concluded that San Jose State University **[violated Title IX by allowing a male player, Blaire Fleming, to compete on the women's volleyball team](https://substack.com/redirect/42202417-fbbe-4186-af4e-e6840d16fe0a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** from 2022 to 2024.
The investigation found that SJSU allegedly attempted to hide Fleming's sex from teammates, coaches, and opponents, denying female athletes equal educational opportunities and benefits in their athletic programs.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/42202417-fbbe-4186-af4e-e6840d16fe0a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Why it matters:** The Office of Civil Rights found that the cover-up forced female athletes to share locker rooms and hotel rooms with a male without their knowledge or consent, creating significant privacy violations. Safety concerns also emerged during competition, as the investigation alleges Fleming spiked the ball with such force that it knocked women on opposing teams to the ground. The situation became so untenable that during one season, seven all-women's teams from other universities chose to forfeit their competitions and accept losses rather than compete against a male player.
* **What 's next:** SJSU has 10 days to comply with a list of mandatory corrective actions or face "imminent enforcement action" from the federal government. The required actions include issuing a public statement adopting biology-based definitions of "male" and "female," acknowledging that the sex of a human is unchangeable, and sending formal apologies to all players who were on the volleyball and beach volleyball teams with Fleming, as well as to players who refused to compete against Fleming.

The secret: Find a card with a "0% intro APR" period for balance transfers. Then, transfer your debt balance and pay it down as much as possible during the intro period. No interest means you could pay off the debt faster. BREAKING: Don Lemon Arrested for Church Protest Former CNN anchor Don Lemon, 59, and taken into federal custody after joining pro-immigration protesters who stormed Cities Church in St. Paul, Minnesota on January 18. He has been charged with conspiracy to deprive rights and violating the FACE Act, which bans interfering with religious services by force. | | ---|---|--- This image is a symbolic recreation, not a photograph Defense Claims First Amendment Protection \- Lemon's attorney Abbe Lowell defended the church storming as "constitutionally protected" journalism, arguing that "the First Amendment exists to protect journalists whose role it is to shine light on the truth." During the incident, Lemon was filmed arguing with a church pastor who called his behavior "shameless," with Lemon insisting his actions were covered by freedom of speech and assembly. Church Targeted Because of Pastor 's ICE Role \- Protesters specifically targeted the church because one of its pastors, David Easterwood, also serves as the acting director of the St. Paul ICE field office. Protest organizer Nekima Levy Armstrong, who was also later arrested, told Lemon they chose to overwhelm the Sunday service because the church was "harboring someone who is commanding ICE agents to terrorize our communities." Trump responds to new footage of Alex Pretti assaulting law enforcement weeks before shooting President Donald Trump video from January 13 showed Pretti spitting at federal immigration officers and violently kicking the taillight off their government SUV during an anti-immigration enforcement protest in Minneapolis. Fatal Shooting During Arrest \- Pretti, a 37-year-old ICU nurse, was fatally shot 11 days later on January 24 during a struggle with Border Patrol agents who had pulled a loaded Sig Sauer pistol from his waistband. DHS investigators believe an errant round from Pretti's own weapon may have prompted agents to fire at least 10 shots at him while he was pinned to the ground. Federal Response to Unrest \- The two Border Patrol agents involved in the shooting have been placed on administrative leave, and Trump sent border czar Tom Homan to Minnesota to de-escalate tensions following the deaths of Pretti and fellow protester Renee Good on January 7. Chinese Communist Party-linked funding discovered behind protest network Neville Roy Singham, a former U.S. tech mogul who sold his IT consulting company for $785 million in 2017 and moved to Shanghai, financing anti-ICE protests in Minneapolis and across the U.S., including the Party for Socialism and Liberation and The People's Forum. | | ---|---|--- Congressional Investigations and Legal Barriers \- Multiple congressional committees have launched investigations into Singham's network, but his residence in China shields him from U.S. subpoenas and enforcement. Lawmakers are concerned that Singham is not registered under the Foreign Agents Registration Act (FARA) despite his alleged ties to CCP propaganda efforts and funding of organizations that "oppose U.S. interests and support U.S. adversaries." Organized Protest Network \- Former federal prosecutors confirm that the Minneapolis demonstrations are supported by organized groups collaborating to mobilize agitators, with evidence suggesting some protesters are being paid to attend. Singham's funding flows through nonprofit organizations with minimal reporting requirements, making it difficult to trace the money and hold him accountable despite FBI investigations dating back to 1974. Kristi Noem responds to call for her resignation DHS Secretary Kristi Noem said "radicals" are targeting her as she from prominent Democrats including Sen. John Fetterman, California Gov. Gavin Newsom, and House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries, as well as some Republicans like Sens. Thom Tillis and Lisa Murkowski, following the fatal shootings of Alex Pretti and Renee Good during immigration enforcement operations in Minnesota. Trump Stands Behind Noem \- President Trump has maintained he has no plans to ask Noem to step down, telling reporters she is doing a "very good job" at securing the border. Noem cited newly released video showing Pretti kicking and spitting at federal agents days before his death as evidence of the hostility officers face, stating that agents have been attacked during operations and even at their hotels while off duty. Leadership Changes and Blame \- Trump replaced Border Patrol commander Greg Bovino with border czar Tom Homan in Minnesota this week. Noem accused Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz and Minneapolis Mayor Jacob Frey of inflaming tensions and refusing to cooperate with federal immigration enforcement, urging them to "change their rhetoric" and work with DHS to address dangerous criminals in their state. California university hit with Title IX violation for allowing male volleyball player to dominate females The U.S. Department of Education's Office for Civil Rights concluded that San Jose State University from 2022 to 2024. The investigation found that SJSU allegedly attempted to hide Fleming's sex from teammates, coaches, and opponents, denying female athletes equal educational opportunities and benefits in their athletic programs. | | ---|---|--- Why it matters: The Office of Civil Rights found that the cover-up forced female athletes to share locker rooms and hotel rooms with a male without their knowledge or consent, creating significant privacy violations. Safety concerns also emerged during competition, as the investigation alleges Fleming spiked the ball with such force that it knocked women on opposing teams to the ground. The situation became so untenable that during one season, seven all-women's teams from other universities chose to forfeit their competitions and accept losses rather than compete against a male player. What 's next: SJSU has 10 days to comply with a list of mandatory corrective actions or face "imminent enforcement action" from the federal government. The required actions include issuing a public statement adopting biology-based definitions of "male" and "female," acknowledging that the sex of a human is unchangeable, and sending formal apologies to all players who were on the volleyball and beach volleyball teams with Fleming, as well as to players who refused to compete against Fleming. * You're currently a free subscriber to . | In the first year of his second term, President Trump has escalated attacks on reproductive freedom–in the U.S. and around the world–through sweeping executive actions. Our new report outlines three urgent trends:
* **Rolling back nationwide protections** including emergency abortion care guidance, safety from clinic violence, and data privacy rules
* **Targeting access even where abortion remains legal** by undermining veterans' care, Medicaid, and Title X family planning programs
* **Fueling misinformation** to justify restrictions on abortion, birth control, and IVF

These actions endanger patients and providers, cut off access to essential health care, and heighten the risk of criminalization and violence. Our report also breaks down what to expect next as these threats continue into 2026. | The Trump administration announced an expansion of the **Global Gag Rule** , blocking U.S. foreign aid from going to any domestic or international organization that supports abortion care, gender-affirming care, or participates in diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives. Historically, the Global Gag Rule has blocked foreign organizations receiving U.S. funds from providing, counseling, or referring for abortion services in their own countries. Research shows the policy reduces access to contraception, maternal and child health care, HIV prevention and treatment, and other essential services—while unintended pregnancies, unsafe abortions, and preventable deaths increase. [👉 Learn more about the Global Gag Rule](https://click.everyaction.com/k/124358077/598349410/1711600904?sourceid=1151118&utm_campaign=26emgfl-0101aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=frontlines&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2M2Q2NzFlZS1mMWZkLWYwMTEtODMyZi0wMDBkM2ExZjBlNGMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nWehp8BQ8dZwYBZtWVuIBNTKjvqosTvzraQ-R3czjZ4=&emci=b9c11208-12fb-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&emdi=63d671ee-f1fd-f011-832f-000d3a1f0e4c&ceid=954237) |

| This month, we secured a landmark victory when Zambia's High Court ruled in favor of our client, [Violet Zulu](https://click.everyaction.com/k/124358080/598349413/1312103955?sourceid=1151118&utm_campaign=26emgfl-0101aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=frontlines&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2M2Q2NzFlZS1mMWZkLWYwMTEtODMyZi0wMDBkM2ExZjBlNGMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nWehp8BQ8dZwYBZtWVuIBNTKjvqosTvzraQ-R3czjZ4=&emci=b9c11208-12fb-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&emdi=63d671ee-f1fd-f011-832f-000d3a1f0e4c&ceid=954237), ordering her immediate release from prison and affirming that the charges brought against her for securing her own abortion were unlawful and unjust. [Violet, a single mother of two and a domestic worker, was arrested and sentenced to seven years in prison after ending her pregnancy on her own.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/124358081/598349414/1312103955?sourceid=1151118&utm_campaign=26emgfl-0101aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=frontlines&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2M2Q2NzFlZS1mMWZkLWYwMTEtODMyZi0wMDBkM2ExZjBlNGMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nWehp8BQ8dZwYBZtWVuIBNTKjvqosTvzraQ-R3czjZ4=&emci=b9c11208-12fb-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&emdi=63d671ee-f1fd-f011-832f-000d3a1f0e4c&ceid=954237) She had been unable to access affordable contraception or abortion care at a local health facility. The cost of contraception (about $2) and a safe abortion (approximately $35) was out of reach. When Violet was charged in January 2024, she had no legal representation and the lower court did not explain the charges against her, the consequences of pleading guilty, or that Zambia’s Termination of Pregnancy Act allows abortion on socio-economic grounds. The Center for Reproductive Rights and our partners filed her appeal. [The High Court’s ruling sets a major legal precedent and underscores the Center’s role in using the law to defend women’s rights, uphold due process, and advance reproductive freedom worldwide.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/124358083/598349419/1312103955?sourceid=1151118&utm_campaign=26emgfl-0101aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=frontlines&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2M2Q2NzFlZS1mMWZkLWYwMTEtODMyZi0wMDBkM2ExZjBlNGMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nWehp8BQ8dZwYBZtWVuIBNTKjvqosTvzraQ-R3czjZ4=&emci=b9c11208-12fb-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&emdi=63d671ee-f1fd-f011-832f-000d3a1f0e4c&ceid=954237) [🔗 Read more about Violet’s case](https://click.everyaction.com/k/124358085/598349424/1312103955?sourceid=1151118&utm_campaign=26emgfl-0101aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=frontlines&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2M2Q2NzFlZS1mMWZkLWYwMTEtODMyZi0wMDBkM2ExZjBlNGMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nWehp8BQ8dZwYBZtWVuIBNTKjvqosTvzraQ-R3czjZ4=&emci=b9c11208-12fb-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&emdi=63d671ee-f1fd-f011-832f-000d3a1f0e4c&ceid=954237) |

clean_body: January Front Lines newsletter | | | | ---|--- | | Front Lines | | January 2026 | ---|---|--- News from the global fight for reproductive rights | The Center for Reproductive Rights works globally to protect and advance reproductive freedom. Through strategic litigation and advocacy, we challenge restrictive policies and promote equitable access to reproductive health care worldwide. Below is a snapshot of our recent efforts: | United States | Trump's (Second) First Year: New and Emerging Threats to Repro Rights | | Photo Credit: Eliyahu Parypa | In the first year of his second term, President Trump has escalated attacks on reproductive freedom–in the U.S. and around the world–through sweeping executive actions. Our new report outlines three urgent trends: Rolling back nationwide protections including emergency abortion care guidance, safety from clinic violence, and data privacy rules Targeting access even where abortion remains legal by undermining veterans' care, Medicaid, and Title X family planning programs Fueling misinformation to justify restrictions on abortion, birth control, and IVF These actions endanger patients and providers, cut off access to essential health care, and heighten the risk of criminalization and violence. Our report also breaks down what to expect next as these threats continue into 2026. | | Trump Admin Expands Anti-Abortion Policy, Threatening Humanitarian Work Worldwide | | | The Trump administration announced an expansion of the Global Gag Rule , blocking U.S. foreign aid from going to any domestic or international organization that supports abortion care, gender-affirming care, or participates in diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives. Historically, the Global Gag Rule has blocked foreign organizations receiving U.S. funds from providing, counseling, or referring for abortion services in their own countries. Research shows the policy reduces access to contraception, maternal and child health care, HIV prevention and treatment, and other essential services—while unintended pregnancies, unsafe abortions, and preventable deaths increase. | | Global | Zambia Court Overturns Conviction, Affirms Reproductive Justice | | Photo Credit: bergserg | This month, we secured a landmark victory when Zambia's High Court ruled in favor of our client, , ordering her immediate release from prison and affirming that the charges brought against her for securing her own abortion were unlawful and unjust. She had been unable to access affordable contraception or abortion care at a local health facility. The cost of contraception (about $2) and a safe abortion (approximately $35) was out of reach. When Violet was charged in January 2024, she had no legal representation and the lower court did not explain the charges against her, the consequences of pleading guilty, or that Zambia’s Termination of Pregnancy Act allows abortion on socio-economic grounds. The Center for Reproductive Rights and our partners filed her appeal. | | “President Trump and his anti-abortion administration would rather let people starve to death in the wake of famine and war than let anyone in the world get an abortion – or even receive information about it.” Rachana Desai Martin Chief US Program Officer * | | Front Lines is dedicated to keeping you informed about the global fight for reproductive rights.
