* * *
I imagine a lot of folks this morning have seen the news: my friend and Wednesday co-host, independent journalist Don Lemon, was arrested by the Trump administration. Let me be blunt--this is a blatant, disturbing abuse of power. Donald Trump is targeting one of the most prominent, fastest-growing independent voices speaking out against what he's doing in this country.
Why? Because Don was covering a protest at a church in Minnesota. Protesters went inside, Don reported on it--live. He interviewed people on both sides. He was there as a journalist. That's it. And yet, for the past two weeks, the Trump administration has been trying to pin the whole protest on him, even though he had nothing to do with planning it. He was observing, reporting, and documenting. Don was exercising his rights under the First Amendment. That coverage constitutes protected journalism carried out through lawful newsgathering.
Let's be clear: the right-wing media machine is celebrating Don's arrest. They're blaming him for something he didn't do. But the real reason Trump's DOJ went after Don Lemon? Because he's effective. He's cutting through the noise. He's holding them accountable--not just in Minnesota, but across the board: economic justice, corruption, immigration, all of it.
Don has built a platform that matters. Over a million subscribers on YouTube alone. His Substack? Killer. His socials? Relentless. And I've been lucky to have him as a friend as I've started my own journey into this space. Don's a good dude. He's sharp, funny, warm, honest--and that's why they're targeting him. They want to make an example out of him. This isn't about lawbreaking. It's about silencing critics. It's about sending a message to people like Don, to people like me, to people like you: if you speak up, they'll come for you.
It's no different from how ICE has been brutalizing peaceful protesters in Minneapolis. Just last night, Trump went after Alex Pretti again--a man who was murdered by ICE agents in broad daylight. Executed in the street for the world to see, for being an "agitator."
And where are all the so-called "free speech absolutists"? The ones always yelling about the First Amendment? Silent. Where are the "Second Amendment defenders" now that Trump's gone after a man who legally owned a gun, didn't brandish it, didn't fire it, and still ended up dead at the hands of his own government? Silent. The hypocrisy is staggering. These people don't care about your rights. They care about power--and using that power to crush anyone who refuses to be complicit.
This administration has consistently reshaped the law to benefit its own corruption, and we are witnessing it in real time. Over and over again. That's what this is. It's not about the law. It's about raw, vengeful, authoritarian power. Trump has gutted the federal government of anyone who might stand up to him, anyone who might say, "this is wrong." And that's why we're sliding--fast--into fascism. This is what authoritarianism looks like.
Even now, Republicans are scrambling on immigration, supposedly their strongest issue. The murders of Alex Pretti and Renee Good have rocked that narrative. But don't kid yourself--this will get worse before it gets better. The more Trump tears down the guardrails, the more brazen the abuse will get. The more he replaces competent public servants with sycophants, the more dangerous things become--for everyone.
They've been trying to arrest Don Lemon for two weeks. Judges have already said this case has no merit. They can't prove he did anything wrong--because he didn't. But that doesn't stop them. It's the same playbook they used against James Comey, against Letitia James, against anyone they think has slighted them or stands in their way. It's all about intimidation, distraction, and wasting your taxpayer dollars in the process.
Meanwhile, federal agencies are being pulled off real threats--terrorists, traffickers, violent criminals--to chase down journalists. To silence critics. To serve Trump's ego. That's not justice. That's not safety. That's not America.
So what do we do? We don't go quiet. We get louder. We show up. We speak out. We make our corner of the world better, however we can. Because--yeah, I know I'm a broken record--it's a million small acts of resistance that beat this guy. Some you'll hear about, most you won't. But they all matter.
So find your fight. Use your voice. And when Don walks free--and I believe that'll happen soon--we make sure they regret coming after him. We make sure his voice is louder, his platform bigger, and his resistance stronger than ever.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal — the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God’s grace.**

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we’re witnessing is not just growth —**it’s revival.**

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

| | Friend,
---
| | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn’t a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal — the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God’s grace.**

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**“God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.”**_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.
---
[](https://trk.greatamericandigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9opqk&__onlt=h)
---
When you read it, you will hear Charlie’s voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family.

Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

**[To claim your copy of this life-changing book, simply make a generous gift in any amount to Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.greatamericandigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9opqk&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://trk.greatamericandigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9opqk&__onlt=h)
---
In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans...

...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — _**it’s the message of FAITH!**_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. _And it’s happening._

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we’re witnessing is not just growth —**it’s revival.**

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families.

We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message.

You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie.

**But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up.**

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, _“We’re not backing down.”_

This is what Charlie prayed for.

I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too.

None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, **_so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith._**

Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God.

**[To claim your copy of Charlie’s final book, simply make a gift, in any amount, to support Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.greatamericandigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9opqk&__onlt=h)**

---
I’ll personally ensure your copy is sent to you as soon as possible.

Thank you in advance for carrying on Charlie’s mission and supporting his legacy.
---
**For Charlie,**

**Justin Streiff**
Chief Operating Officer

With her first year in the United States Senate complete, Angela
Alsobrooks is preparing for an even more productive second year.

She spoke to the Washington Post about finding her place as a legislator,
building relationships with fellow Senators, and learning how to get
things done in spite of extreme partisan gridlock.

In 2025, she worked with colleagues across the aisle to invest in early
detection and treatment of uterine fibroids, increasing tax credits for
beauty industry businesses, and giving homeless youth access to more
services.

She also exposed RFK Jr.'s lies in Senate hearings and hasn't stopped
holding his feet to the fire.

Unlike most Senators with net worths in the multi-millions, Angela deals
with the same challenges so many Marylanders face. Her dad’s medication
recently spiked to $800 a month. She hears similar stories every week
while she shops at the Wegmans – stories that fuel her efforts in the
Senate.

In 2026, Angela wants working families to be able to do more than just pay
the bills: buy homes, save for retirement, and build wealth for the
future.

Go further and do better. That's her mission every day, from now until
2030, and beyond.

Last Saturday, ICE agents shot and killed Alex Pretti in Minneapolis. Less than three weeks earlier, they killed Renee Good in the same city.
Both were protesters. Both were exercising their First Amendment rights.
And now we know something else that should alarm every American.
In the aftermath of Alex Pretti's killing, Attorney General Pam Bondi offered Minnesota a deal:
Hand over your voter records, and the Trump administration will stop the ICE invasion.

The violence in Minneapolis was never about immigration. It is about rigging elections.
Before Alex Pretti was killed, Trump and MAGA's poll numbers were collapsing. They know they are headed toward massive losses in 2026 and 2028, losses that could sideline them for a generation.
Unless they can rig elections.
For months, Trump has been demanding access to state voter records. He has been threatening governors and state officials to get them. MAGA learned from 2020 that if you want to steal an election, you don't wait until Election Day, you control the process before the votes are cast.
That's also why the FBI just raided Fulton County, Georgia election offices and seized their 2020 ballots and vote tabulations, opening the door for Trump to resurface claims about stolen elections and create pretense for even more extreme actions to rig elections.
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001f3oae3QBRBq_9qvstwAlbYKNxpx4sQiAPy3REK-77i93bMSmJ3lSzBr9yDSU1oJQlVqxVfqe855608meZI868r7JPmh_2vk2sAdGasglDUxQBv5C0ENbplZQcvm9wvQXE1pnGRMdYKcyJ9tb1iOtfJcdvwSP5VPcx3-HnuRpwOgHvWB_AQL89WD4hFWyjfxtzVZQwvprhGuXbGmGzFZjJZ3c0pDyMiC0Jez2mcgUjLYGN2ACEqTqgQ==&c=UCMzkk_FxlUQEjMfxxbadjGnOdBfh25KjnTKH7w6qWoTCqBjpRKxuQ==&ch=VOzfv_t4Fx4N0rmnnLdn6Izj9aqiI3Anm26tOzktGUV14aFra22Sug==)
---
But here's the truth Trump's desperate to bury:
Elections are state matters. They are not run by the federal government.
That is why they are trying to strong-arm states. And that is where we can stop them.
With strong, independent, pro-democracy state Supreme Courts, the courts that ultimately decide election cases, we can block these abuses, protect voter privacy, and ensure that Americans, not fascists, decide our elections.
Pam Bondi said the quiet part out loud. Now we must act to counter MAGA before it's too late.
That is why the mission of Defend Our Courts has never been more critical, and why we need your help right now.

body:
Times like these aren’t easy, but they show who you can really count on.
#

Team —
I’ll get right to it: At the end of this email, I’m going to ask you for a donation.
But before I do, let me explain why. I know I owe you that much.
So, here’s the truth.
Times like these aren’t easy, but they show who you can really count on.
I’ll do whatever I can to stop Trump from tearing our nation apart, and I’d do it on my own if I had to. But over the past several weeks and months, I think we’ve all learned that we’re far from alone. There are millions of us, and together we can make a real difference.
I’ve seen it in the wave of support you sent my way after Trump and Hegseth started threatening me. We’ve all seen it in the people making a stand for our country. And I am here to tell you: You can count on me to do my part.
That means stopping Republicans in Congress from giving Trump’s Department of Homeland Security a blank check and voting against their budget this week.
It means suing Pete Hegseth for trying to silence me and for chilling retired veterans' right to free speech along the way.
It means traveling the country supporting the candidates we need to win back the House and Senate because electing more Democrats is the single most important thing we can do to stop Trump’s agenda. But I need your help to do it.

Two days ago, Team, the FBI raided the Fulton County, Georgia (home to Atlanta) Elections Operation Center. The Atlanta Journal Constitution (AJC) reported that the activity was “ apparently connected to the Trump administration’s long-held and disproven belief that Fulton’s handling of the 2020 presidential election was rife with fraud .”
You read that right -- instead of focusing on the crucial issues facing our country, MAGA and Trump have weaponized the investigative power of the Justice Department and the FBI to try and justify their lies that the 2020 election was stolen from him .
The search warrant authorized agents to search for and seize all “physical ballots from the 2020 general election” as well as ballot images produced by scanning ballots, voter rolls from that year, and tabulator tapes. It’s highly unlikely the investigation will turn up any vote count fraud connected to the 2020 election results in Fulton County as those results, like elsewhere, have been recounted, audited, and litigated already, costing millions in taxpayer dollars and finding no misdeeds.
That's not stopping the opponents of voting rights in the Trump administration, however. This is their perfect opportunity for a test run of their suppressive power ahead of November's midterm elections.
We must do everything we can to protect our free and fair elections -- not just before them, but during and after. Help our fight to make every vote count with $35 or whatever you can today >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=013026_1&amount=35]

Needless to say, the DNI doesn't have any law enforcement role and has no power over domestic issues. Senator Mark Warner, ranking member on the Senate Intelligence Committee ( which is required by law to be informed of foreign intelligence issues ), said they haven't been informed of any reason for her involvement, despite Trump later going on Truth Social to claim that an out-of-power former President Obama took millions of dollars in cash payments in 2020 meant for Iran and diverted the money to Italy to pay for the CIA to hack voting machines in coordination with China.
Feeling lost? Us too. Rather than understand the simple truth that voters changed their mind about Trump after his first term and wanted to give someone else a try in charge, these conspiracy theorists would rather believe that a country that hates America (Iran) wouldn't complain about not getting paid. And that Iran would be OK with a former president taking millions of dollars to pay an American ally (Italy) and a world superpower (China) to work with an American government agency (the CIA) to hack voting machines using satellites. All to change *just enough* votes to win.
While this sounds like the worst movie plot you've ever heard of, it's our reality, and worst of all, the people entrusted to run our country actually believe it . body:
The violence in Minneapolis was never about immigration. It is about rigging elections.
| | | | | [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001AWatDqMHpLVRC2jVqm2B6pFg6Hv0O--8_Qjsd0Eyf2ZF3dqp5Dch4uwc9bgG6UiXtk86Y9jP2xfsEFF4CZ7YGJA92IBZpvzYqc-xzKXp8RGjl4sRVoeAdo2He-b_LwH6CdeGh6b6pz1G0qRuZCofnJv_2XrlMMcZqnrqHZRzToNZo5JNmO6EAWX4iFiKufgg7Buh8zYOSL-rYJuvuycK4Xt61OwH_5w-3davpckvY-o=&c=Uk6aKuvAQ6Q53Z3NG-RD1qcbeT0Q7PfB06Lp2JEEiMHXcvPFIZ2QXg==&ch=ytrjH7x1tb6R_QH_kr9mjOK0CrJtPUOxOCfuTzqALLyAP1PR3GAu5w==)
---
| Peter,
Last Saturday, ICE agents shot and killed Alex Pretti in Minneapolis. Less than three weeks earlier, they killed Renee Good in the same city.
Both were protesters. Both were exercising their First Amendment rights.
And now we know something else that should alarm every American.
In the aftermath of Alex Pretti's killing, Attorney General Pam Bondi offered Minnesota a deal:
Hand over your voter records, and the Trump administration will stop the ICE invasion.
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001AWatDqMHpLVRC2jVqm2B6pFg6Hv0O--8_Qjsd0Eyf2ZF3dqp5Dch4uwc9bgG6UiXtk86Y9jP2xfsEFF4CZ7YGJA92IBZpvzYqc-xzKXp8RGjl4sRVoeAdo2He-b_LwH6CdeGh6b6pz1G0qRuZCofnJv_2XrlMMcZqnrqHZRzToNZo5JNmO6EAWX4iFiKufgg7Buh8zYOSL-rYJuvuycK4divfEau2YwEowhWi4o8eW0=&c=Uk6aKuvAQ6Q53Z3NG-RD1qcbeT0Q7PfB06Lp2JEEiMHXcvPFIZ2QXg==&ch=ytrjH7x1tb6R_QH_kr9mjOK0CrJtPUOxOCfuTzqALLyAP1PR3GAu5w==)
---
That tells you everything you need to know.
The violence in Minneapolis was never about immigration. It is about rigging elections.
Before Alex Pretti was killed, Trump and MAGA's poll numbers were collapsing. They know they are headed toward massive losses in 2026 and 2028, losses that could sideline them for a generation.
Unless they can rig elections.
For months, Trump has been demanding access to state voter records. He has been threatening governors and state officials to get them. MAGA learned from 2020 that if you want to steal an election, you don't wait until Election Day, you control the process before the votes are cast.
That's also why the FBI just raided Fulton County, Georgia election offices and seized their 2020 ballots and vote tabulations, opening the door for Trump to resurface claims about stolen elections and create pretense for even more extreme actions to rig elections.
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001AWatDqMHpLVRC2jVqm2B6pFg6Hv0O--8_Qjsd0Eyf2ZF3dqp5Dch4uwc9bgG6UiXtk86Y9jP2xfsEFF4CZ7YGJA92IBZpvzYqc-xzKXp8RGjl4sRVoeAdo2He-b_LwH6CdeGh6b6pz1G0qRuZCofnJv_2XrlMMcZqnrqHZRzToNZo5JNmO6EAWX4iFiKufgg7Buh8zYOSL-rYJuvuycK4YhNNFFg5q7kCLwqlc1HcAg=&c=Uk6aKuvAQ6Q53Z3NG-RD1qcbeT0Q7PfB06Lp2JEEiMHXcvPFIZ2QXg==&ch=ytrjH7x1tb6R_QH_kr9mjOK0CrJtPUOxOCfuTzqALLyAP1PR3GAu5w==)
---
But here's the truth Trump's desperate to bury:
Elections are state matters. They are not run by the federal government.
That is why they are trying to strong-arm states. And that is where we can stop them.
With strong, independent, pro-democracy state Supreme Courts, the courts that ultimately decide election cases, we can block these abuses, protect voter privacy, and ensure that Americans, not fascists, decide our elections.
Pam Bondi said the quiet part out loud. Now we must act to counter MAGA before it's too late.
That is why the mission of Defend Our Courts has never been more critical, and why we need your help right now.

name: Katie Hobbs
subject: It wasn’t an easy decision to make
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
#

[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-hobbs-2026.jja-Gd&refcode=em260130-1-b&t=1&akid=11216%2E3935704%2Eouk3Sx)
---
Team, it’s Katie Hobbs. I want to tell you about an important decision I made a few years ago.
**If you’re short on time and want to skip ahead to split a donation between me and GIFFORDS PAC, you can use this link:** **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/giffords-em-hobbs-2026](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-hobbs-2026.jja-Gd&refcode=em260130-1-b&t=2&akid=11216%2E3935704%2Eouk3Sx)**
_Otherwise, keep reading:_
During the 2020 election, I was Arizona’s Secretary of State. I had a job to do: **Count every vote.**
Donald Trump and the extremists surrounding him didn’t make it easy. Like millions of Americans, I watched as an enraged crowd breached the halls of our nation’s Capitol in Washington, D.C. to overturn the people’s vote.
**When the “Stop the Steal” movement took hold, I was harassed and even received death threats because of my role in overseeing Arizona’s elections.**
Some would believe that in moments like these, you only have two options — fight, or give in. **I chose to get the job done.** We counted every vote, and in the middle of a once-in-a-century pandemic, we proved that democracy works.
But I knew the work wasn’t over. It was clear that the MAGA right wouldn’t offer any real solutions; they’d just offer more and more conspiracy theories and scapegoats.
So I decided to launch my campaign for governor to deliver transparency, accountability, and results for Arizonans. My opponents and national Republicans spent tens of millions of dollars and lobbed baseless attacks to try and defeat me, but thanks to hundreds of thousands of grassroots supporters chipping in what they could, we won with less than 1% of the vote.
That brings us to _today._
Years later, we’ve delivered incredible progress for Arizonans — lowering healthcare costs, investing in public education, and cutting taxes for middle-class families, just to name a few things. But there’s still more work to do.
I’m running to deliver another four years of progress like this, but Donald Trump, my __three__ GOP opponents, and the national Republican establishment are determined to unseat me and flip this seat **red**.
Experts are calling this year’s Arizona governor’s race a **pure toss-up** , just like they did in 2022. But I’m telling you now — this race is going to be even more competitive and even more expensive than the first time.
I know it might feel early to be reading emails like this, but these are the stakes. This is the level of competition in this race. And if we’re going to win this, we have to build a serious grassroots campaign from the very start.
[**So please, split $10, $25, or whatever amount you’re able to my campaign and GIFFORDS PAC to help me win this 50/50 race, defend our hard-won progress, and serve another four years as governor of Arizona. I can’t do this without you!**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-hobbs-2026.jja-Gd&refcode=em260130-1-b&t=3&akid=11216%2E3935704%2Eouk3Sx)

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/124363914/598368129/510768709?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTIzMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1OTYzOTgzZS1mN2ZkLWYwMTEtODMyZi0wMDBkM2ExZjBlNGMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EwvQIEAM8sTJV57DE_QvjPDZLs12T9NWNUu0KVaisXM=) Hi there — Sean McCann here. **_[In a moment, I’ll ask you to pitch in $10 or whatever you can spare before our upcoming end-of-month fundraising deadline.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/124363919/598368132/819412648?amounts=5,10,15,25,50,100,250,500&amount=10&refcode=email_013026_bioRF&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTIzMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1OTYzOTgzZS1mN2ZkLWYwMTEtODMyZi0wMDBkM2ExZjBlNGMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EwvQIEAM8sTJV57DE_QvjPDZLs12T9NWNUu0KVaisXM=)_** But first, I wanted to tell you about my background, my values, and why I need your support today. I hope you’ll take a moment to read this email to the end, and I apologize that it’s on the longer side. **So many members of Congress today have never been middle- or working-class a day in their lives. My story is different.** I grew up in a middle-class family in Michigan. We always had a roof over our heads, but we faced our share of tough years, especially after my parents split up. We made the kinds of small sacrifices that most families across Michigan know so well — putting off home repairs and stretching our grocery budget as far as it would go. My mom was a teacher, and I’m a proud public school kid all the way through. In fact, the very first office I was elected to was on the student government at Western Michigan University right here in Kalamazoo! **I’m not in this fight to help out billionaires and special interests. I’m in this fight to get things done for my community — for the regular families who Washington has turned its back on.** Our community here in Southwest Michigan means the world to me, and I knew I wanted to spend my life in public service. So I ran for a seat on the Kalamazoo City Commission, and after I won, I got right to work on the kinds of issues that don’t make the front pages but make a huge difference in people’s lives — repairing sidewalks, helping out small businesses, fixing a clanking manhole cover that was keeping people up at night. After that, I was elected to serve in the state legislature, where I’ve focused every day on getting things done for working families — whether it was expanding Medicaid or delivering tax relief for working families and seniors. **I’ve always believed that if you work hard and focus on what matters, you can get things done. And that’s exactly what I intend to do in Congress.** I’ll put partisan politics aside and focus on what matters to regular people here in Michigan’s 4th District. That means protecting access to affordable health care, cutting costs for working families, and standing between you and ANYONE who tries to attack your fundamental rights and freedoms. But first, I need your help to get us over the finish line in November. We’ve already built significant momentum. In just the last few months: Michigan Governor Gretchen Whitmer and Secretary of State Jocelyn Benson have endorsed my campaign. A poll showed me only 2 points behind Bill Huizenga. A top contender in the Democratic primary dropped out of the race, clearing the primary field. And analysts upgraded our chances of winning this race. **_[So if you’re with me, can you chip in to my campaign before Saturday’s end-of-month deadline? clean_body: = Hi there — Sean McCann here. = But first, I wanted to tell you about my background, my values, and why I need your support today. I hope you’ll take a moment to read this email to the end, and I apologize that it’s on the longer side. So many members of Congress today have never been middle- or working-class a day in their lives. My story is different. I grew up in a middle-class family in Michigan. We always had a roof over our heads, but we faced our share of tough years, especially after my parents split up. We made the kinds of small sacrifices that most families across Michigan know so well — putting off home repairs and stretching our grocery budget as far as it would go. My mom was a teacher, and I’m a proud public school kid all the way through. In fact, the very first office I was elected to was on the student government at Western Michigan University right here in Kalamazoo! I’m not in this fight to help out billionaires and special interests. I’m in this fight to get things done for my community — for the regular families who Washington has turned its back on. Our community here in Southwest Michigan means the world to me, and I knew I wanted to spend my life in public service. So I ran for a seat on the Kalamazoo City Commission, and after I won, I got right to work on the kinds of issues that don’t make the front pages but make a huge difference in people’s lives — repairing sidewalks, helping out small businesses, fixing a clanking manhole cover that was keeping people up at night. After that, I was elected to serve in the state legislature, where I’ve focused every day on getting things done for working families — whether it was expanding Medicaid or delivering tax relief for working families and seniors. I’ve always believed that if you work hard and focus on what matters, you can get things done. And that’s exactly what I intend to do in Congress. I’ll put partisan politics aside and focus on what matters to regular people here in Michigan’s 4th District. body:
Here in Pennsylvania, we’re doing something about it

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/124364199/598368964/1156619579?refcode=email_012826_frustrated&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhOWUzNDZjZi1mN2ZkLWYwMTEtODMyZi0wMDBkM2ExZjBlNGMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5g_6nB6WDyLGuS8qGM0bh4Hy2F69KI2TV0uA6EGtFYk=) Derek, this is Josh Shapiro, and I want to be completely upfront: Yes, this is a fundraising email. [_**I hope you’ll take a moment to read my note about the frustration so many of us are feeling right now, then chip in to help me keep up the fight for progress, affordability, and real freedom.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/124364200/598368965/1156619579?refcode=email_012826_frustrated&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhOWUzNDZjZi1mN2ZkLWYwMTEtODMyZi0wMDBkM2ExZjBlNGMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5g_6nB6WDyLGuS8qGM0bh4Hy2F69KI2TV0uA6EGtFYk=) | | [Donate →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/124364201/598368966/1156619579?refcode=email_012826_frustrated&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhOWUzNDZjZi1mN2ZkLWYwMTEtODMyZi0wMDBkM2ExZjBlNGMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5g_6nB6WDyLGuS8qGM0bh4Hy2F69KI2TV0uA6EGtFYk=)
---
If you’ve spent the last year feeling frustrated — or even infuriated — with politics, you’re not alone.
In DC, politicians like Donald Trump haven’t even pretended to give a sh*t about hard-working folks across Pennsylvania. They’ve jacked up costs, slashed health care, and ripped food away from hungry kids.
Meanwhile, when these far-right politicians hit the campaign trail, they act like it never happened. They lie to our faces and claim that costs have magically decreased... when all of us know we’re paying more than ever for housing, for groceries, and nearly everything else.
But here in Pennsylvania? We’re doing something about it, Derek. Not just pretending to.
Under my Administration, we’ve cut taxes seven times — putting more money into the pockets of nearly 1 million Pennsylvanians. We’ve created over 18,000 good-paying jobs and expanded economic opportunity across our Commonwealth. And we’ve made record investments in what _really_ matters — education, public safety, and so much more.
**So Derek, if you’re one of the millions of Pennsylvanians who can’t stand what’s coming out of Washington... know that I’m with you. And this campaign is the polar opposite.**

**I'm not a politician, I haven't run for office before, and elected office wasn't really an endgame I'd ever thought about. But what Tim Walz, the far-Left, and the career politicians have done to our state forced me to reconsider, including when they ... **
**- STORMED our churches to intimidate worshippers - SQUANDERED our tax dollars on fraudulent daycares- DEMONIZED our brave cops and border agents- ALLOWED men into women's locker rooms - TAXED us into oblivion with zero tangible benefits - SUED the Trump Admin to allow boys in girls' sports- OPENED our borders to millions of illegal immigrants- FORCED divisive propaganda into our classrooms**
**As a sports professional, patriot, Catholic, granddaughter of legal immigrants, wife, and mama bear, they've come after just about everything I care about most. So I had a choice to make: 1) let my state and country descend into ruin, or 2) take a leap of faith to fix it. **
**Experts and consultants told me running for Senate in Minnesota was a fool's errand. **
**After all, we have a far-Left Governor and two far-Left Senators, Minnesota has been a blue state since Nixon, and it's the ONLY STATE Ronald Reagan didn't win. **
**But blazing my own trail has never scared me. I made history on TV and won four Emmys for my sports coverage. I've taken on longer odds than this - and I beat them. **

**Luckily, there are a lot more of us than there are of them! **
**Now that I have made my decision, my path to winning this Senate race is in your hands. The ONLY way we can flip this seat is by out-organizing, out-working, and out-raising our opponents.**

clean_body: Hi folks! I just made it official: I‘m running for U.S. Senate! - my name is Michele Tafoya. I made a career as a sideline reporter for some of the biggest moments in sports history. I spent many Sunday evenings out on the gridiron. And I've interviewed all-time greats, including Peyton Manning, Patrick Mahomes, and many others who changed the game forever. Now I'm ready to make a big change myself. With the disaster that failed leadership has brought us to in Minnesota, I just made it official: I'm running for U.S. Senate in my home state of Minnesota! Before I go on, this will be one of the most consequential Senate races in the entire country - is there anything I can say to convince you to become a to my new campaign? never in my life thought I'd be sending you this email. I'm not a politician, I haven't run for office before, and elected office wasn't really an endgame I'd ever thought about. But what Tim Walz, the far-Left, and the career politicians have done to our state forced me to reconsider, including when they ... - STORMED our churches to intimidate worshippers - SQUANDERED our tax dollars on fraudulent daycares- DEMONIZED our brave cops and border agents- ALLOWED men into women's locker rooms - TAXED us into oblivion with zero tangible benefits - SUED the Trump Admin to allow boys in girls' sports- OPENED our borders to millions of illegal immigrants- FORCED divisive propaganda into our classrooms As a sports professional, patriot, Catholic, granddaughter of legal immigrants, wife, and mama bear, they've come after just about everything I care about most. So I had a choice to make: 1) let my state and country descend into ruin, or 2) take a leap of faith to fix it. Experts and consultants told me running for Senate in Minnesota was a fool's errand. After all, we have a far-Left Governor and two far-Left Senators, Minnesota has been a blue state since Nixon, and it's the ONLY STATE Ronald Reagan didn't win. Now that I have made my decision, my path to winning this Senate race is in your hands. The ONLY way we can flip this seat is by out-organizing, out-working, and out-raising our opponents. name: Ilhan Omar
subject: The difference between Trump and me
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
Donald Trump wouldn’t last a minute in my shoes.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2061%2E791427%2E0cV06s)
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/4868?t=2&akid=2061%2E791427%2E0cV06s)
Friend,
I was born in Somalia at the start of a brutal civil war. My mother died when I was just two. My family was forced to flee the country, and we spent four long years living in a refugee camp in Kenya.
We were eventually granted asylum and came to America as refugees without a penny to our name. It wasn’t easy to get by.
After my father landed his first job, it became clear that one minimum wage paycheck wasn’t going to be enough. I started cleaning office buildings, and throughout high school and college, worked as a cashier, security guard, educator, and policy analyst to make ends meet.
Throughout my life, I faced harassment for my religion, my hijab, my race, my accent – you name it. But eventually, I found my home and my community in Minneapolis. I began getting involved and organizing, and in 2016, I ran for state office for the first time and won. In 2018, I ran for Congress, and along with Rashida Tlaib, became the first Muslim woman to serve in this historic body.
**Donald Trump wouldn’t have lasted a minute in my shoes.**
Trump is the definition of privileged. Born with a silver spoon and daddy’s money, Trump was handed the best education and experience in his industry that money could buy. He was still a massive failure who bankrupted businesses and made a laughingstock of his family name.
My story taught me the value of hard work. It taught me the promise of the American dream. It taught me to have compassion for those in tough situations. It taught me the importance of loving your neighbor, not hating them. These are things Trump couldn’t possibly understand.
Dr. King famously said: “Darkness cannot drive out darkness; only light can do that. Hate cannot drive out hate; only love can do that.”
Yes, Trump is a vile, hate-filled individual who is driving our nation to the brink of chaos and letting billionaires pick our pockets. He lies about me and inspires crazy people to attack me like we saw the other night.
But I will not stop fighting, joyfully, for my fellow neighbors. I will not stop loving America and dreaming of a future where everyone has the healthcare, housing, education, safety, and affordable life that they deserve.
[**Friend — Tomorrow is our first fundraising deadline of 2026. I am asking you to chip in today and help me keep fighting for the American dream in the face of Trump’s violent fascism and attacks on my community. We have to send a message that compassion beats bullies. My family was forced to flee the country, and we spent four long years living in a refugee camp in Kenya. We were eventually granted asylum and came to America as refugees without a penny to our name. It wasn’t easy to get by. After my father landed his first job, it became clear that one minimum wage paycheck wasn’t going to be enough. I started cleaning office buildings, and throughout high school and college, worked as a cashier, security guard, educator, and policy analyst to make ends meet. Throughout my life, I faced harassment for my religion, my hijab, my race, my accent – you name it. But eventually, I found my home and my community in Minneapolis. I began getting involved and organizing, and in 2016, I ran for state office for the first time and won. In 2018, I ran for Congress, and along with Rashida Tlaib, became the first Muslim woman to serve in this historic body. Donald Trump wouldn’t have lasted a minute in my shoes. Trump is the definition of privileged. Born with a silver spoon and daddy’s money, Trump was handed the best education and experience in his industry that money could buy. He was still a massive failure who bankrupted businesses and made a laughingstock of his family name. My story taught me the value of hard work. It taught me the promise of the American dream. It taught me to have compassion for those in tough situations. It taught me the importance of loving your neighbor, not hating them. These are things Trump couldn’t possibly understand. Dr. King famously said: “Darkness cannot drive out darkness; only light can do that. Hate cannot drive out hate; only love can do that.” Yes, Trump is a vile, hate-filled individual who is driving our nation to the brink of chaos and letting billionaires pick our pockets. He lies about me and inspires crazy people to attack me like we saw the other night. But I will not stop fighting, joyfully, for my fellow neighbors. I will not stop loving America and dreaming of a future where everyone has the healthcare, housing, education, safety, and affordable life that they deserve. Hi there — I wanted you to be one of the first to hear the news: I’m running for governor of the state of Minnesota. **This is a home-grown campaign, born in a moment like no other.** **[I’m going to tell you why in a moment. But first: Will you help us get off to a strong start by splitting a donation between Fight Like Hell PAC and my campaign?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/124367859/598381307/1636659928?refcode=AU_FLHP_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20260130_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY0NjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDU1ZGExYmYtZmRmZC1mMDExLTgzMmYtMDAwZDNhMWYwZTRjIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=9aknyebsDjvTBfWqpCyMfwnwfuRB3rIamojparLnGH4=)** I’m not going to sugar coat it — Minnesota has been through a lot. Our state has been the center of America’s heartbreak. But we have also been the center of America's courage and America's hope. In moments of enormous difficulty, we find strength in our Minnesota values of hard work, freedom, and simple decency and good will. **These moments call for grit and resilience.** I’ve learned resilience from the people of Minnesota. Here's a story I'll never forget, once I learned the truth behind it.

In 1917, a small group of revolutionaries led by Vladimir Lenin seized power in Russia. They promised a better, fairer world...sound familiar?

But soon after taking control, they began rounding up and executing anyone who stood in their way. Lenin even ordered his followers to hang landowners and seize their crops--so that for miles around, "people see, and tremble..."

Marxism began with promises of a perfect world--and ended in fear, famine, and death.

You may be familiar with that dark history, but too many Americans aren't. How do I know?

Because a century later, these dangerous ideas have been repackaged and rebranded. They're taught in schools and promoted by celebrity politicians using words such as "equity," "diversity," and "social justice."

The words sound harmless, but the ideas behind them are the same. Will they end up with the same terrifying results?

| | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn’t a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal — the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God’s grace.**

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**“God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.”**_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.
---
[](https://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9otib&__onlt=h)
---
When you read it, you will hear Charlie’s voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family.

Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

---
In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans...

...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — _**it’s the message of FAITH!**_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. _And it’s happening._

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we’re witnessing is not just growth —**it’s revival.**

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families.

We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message.

You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie.

**But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up.**

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, _“We’re not backing down.”_

This is what Charlie prayed for.

I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too.

None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, **_so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith._**

Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God.

Thank you in advance for carrying on Charlie’s mission and supporting his legacy.

**Justin Streiff**

Turning Point USA

Conservative Josh Higgins Files Lawsuit Alleging Illinois GOP Used Illegal Postage to Protect Norine Hammond (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2026/01/conservative-josh-higgins-files-lawsuit-alleging-illinois-gop-used-illegal-postage-to-protect-norine-hammond.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=0c37166697-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2026/01/conservative-josh-higgins-files-lawsuit-alleging-illinois-gop-used-illegal-postage-to-protect-norine-hammond.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=0c37166697-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823
Conservative Illinois State Rep. candidate Josh Higgins. (WGEM/Screenshot)
By Illinois Review

A conservative grassroots challenger has taken the Illinois Republican Party to court, alleging a coordinated scheme to illegally use nonprofit postage discounts to benefit embattled State Rep. Norine Hammond during a contested Republican primary – a practice Illinois Review first uncovered more than three years ago.

On January 28, 2026, Citizens for Josh Higgins filed a verified complaint in Henderson County Circuit Court (9th Judicial Circuit) seeking declaratory and injunctive relief against the Illinois Republican Party, party chair Kathleen Salvi, party general counsel John Fogarty Jr., executive director Matthew Janes, the House Republican Organization (HRO), HRO chair Amy Elik, and Citizens for Hammond, Hammond’s campaign committee. The lawsuit was filed by attorney Thomas DeVore of DeVore Law Offices, LLC.
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2026/01/conservative-josh-higgins-files-lawsuit-alleging-illinois-gop-used-illegal-postage-to-protect-norine-hammond.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=0c37166697-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823
In addition to the complaint, plaintiffs have filed an emergency motion for a preliminary injunction. A court hearing on the motion has been scheduled, with plaintiffs seeking to immediately halt the alleged practice ahead of the Republican primary.

The lawsuit alleges violations of U.S. Postal Service nonprofit mail standards, which strictly limit who may lawfully use discounted nonprofit mailing rates in elections.

According to the complaint, the Illinois GOP is a qualified political committee authorized to use a nonprofit mail indicia. Hammond’s campaign committee and the House Republican Organization, however, are not qualified under USPS standards and are prohibited from sending political mail at discounted nonprofit rates.

Plaintiffs allege the Illinois GOP nevertheless allowed Hammond unlawful access to its nonprofit mail indicia, dramatically reducing her mailing costs while her conservative challenger, Josh Higgins, was forced to pay full postage rates exceeding 40 cents per mailer.
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2026/01/conservative-josh-higgins-files-lawsuit-alleging-illinois-gop-used-illegal-postage-to-protect-norine-hammond.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=0c37166697-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823
The allegations echo reporting by Illinois Review dating back to the 2022 election cycle, when the outlet uncovered that the Illinois GOP selectively allowed establishment candidates to benefit from the party’s nonprofit postage privileges.

At the time, state party officials acknowledged that gubernatorial candidate Richard Irvin was permitted to use party-backed mailings at discounted rates – while other Republican primary candidates were denied the same access.

That reporting triggered scrutiny from postal officials and highlighted what Illinois Review described as a pattern of party leadership using nonprofit privileges to tilt contested primaries in favor of preferred candidates.

In the current case, court filings outline a series of financial transfers plaintiffs argue demonstrate a similar scheme.

Between April 2025 and January 2026, Hammond’s campaign allegedly transferred $32,780 to the House Republican Organization. On January 16, 2026, the HRO then advanced $50,000 to the Illinois GOP.

https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2026/01/conservative-josh-higgins-files-lawsuit-alleging-illinois-gop-used-illegal-postage-to-protect-norine-hammond.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=0c37166697-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823
Illinois State Rep. Norine Hammond. (Rich Egger/TSPR)
The complaint alleges those funds were earmarked to cover mailing costs, or provide consideration, for political mail sent on Hammond’s behalf.

On or about January 26, 2026, the Illinois GOP allegedly mailed a campaign piece supporting Hammond bearing the party’s nonprofit mail indicia. The filing states the mailer was approved by Fogarty and Janes and would not have been sent absent the $50,000 transfer.

The arrangement allegedly allowed Hammond’s mail to be sent at less than 20 cents per piece – a cost advantage unavailable to Higgins, who paid standard rates because his campaign is not eligible for nonprofit postage discounts.

Citizens for Higgins argues the conduct violates USPS Standard 1.6.10, which prohibits nonprofit mailings when a candidate or non-qualified entity pays for, prepares, or provides consideration for the mailing.

The lawsuit seeks a declaratory judgment and court orders barring the practice from continuing. Party officials named in the lawsuit have not publicly responded to the allegations as of publication.

Illinois Review is the largest conservative media source in Illinois, and the only source in Illinois that has been shared by President Donald Trump. X () Facebook () IllinoisReview.com () Conservative Josh Higgins Files Lawsuit Alleging Illinois GOP Used Illegal Postage to Protect Norine Hammond () Conservative Illinois State Rep. candidate Josh Higgins. (WGEM/Screenshot) By Illinois Review A conservative grassroots challenger has taken the Illinois Republican Party to court, alleging a coordinated scheme to illegally use nonprofit postage discounts to benefit embattled State Rep. Norine Hammond during a contested Republican primary – a practice Illinois Review first uncovered more than three years ago. On January 28, 2026, Citizens for Josh Higgins filed a verified complaint in Henderson County Circuit Court (9th Judicial Circuit) seeking declaratory and injunctive relief against the Illinois Republican Party, party chair Kathleen Salvi, party general counsel John Fogarty Jr., executive director Matthew Janes, the House Republican Organization (HRO), HRO chair Amy Elik, and Citizens for Hammond, Hammond’s campaign committee. The lawsuit was filed by attorney Thomas DeVore of DeVore Law Offices, LLC. In addition to the complaint, plaintiffs have filed an emergency motion for a preliminary injunction. A court hearing on the motion has been scheduled, with plaintiffs seeking to immediately halt the alleged practice ahead of the Republican primary. The lawsuit alleges violations of U.S. Postal Service nonprofit mail standards, which strictly limit who may lawfully use discounted nonprofit mailing rates in elections. According to the complaint, the Illinois GOP is a qualified political committee authorized to use a nonprofit mail indicia. Hammond’s campaign committee and the House Republican Organization, however, are not qualified under USPS standards and are prohibited from sending political mail at discounted nonprofit rates. Plaintiffs allege the Illinois GOP nevertheless allowed Hammond unlawful access to its nonprofit mail indicia, dramatically reducing her mailing costs while her conservative challenger, Josh Higgins, was forced to pay full postage rates exceeding 40 cents per mailer. The allegations echo reporting by Illinois Review dating back to the 2022 election cycle, when the outlet uncovered that the Illinois GOP selectively allowed establishment candidates to benefit from the party’s nonprofit postage privileges. At the time, state party officials acknowledged that gubernatorial candidate Richard Irvin was permitted to use party-backed mailings at discounted rates – while other Republican primary candidates were denied the same access. That reporting triggered scrutiny from postal officials and highlighted what Illinois Review described as a pattern of party leadership using nonprofit privileges to tilt contested primaries in favor of preferred candidates. In the current case, court filings outline a series of financial transfers plaintiffs argue demonstrate a similar scheme. Between April 2025 and January 2026, Hammond’s campaign allegedly transferred $32,780 to the House Republican Organization. On January 16, 2026, the HRO then advanced $50,000 to the Illinois GOP. Illinois State Rep. Norine Hammond. (Rich Egger/TSPR) The complaint alleges those funds were earmarked to cover mailing costs, or provide consideration, for political mail sent on Hammond’s behalf. On or about January 26, 2026, the Illinois GOP allegedly mailed a campaign piece supporting Hammond bearing the party’s nonprofit mail indicia. The filing states the mailer was approved by Fogarty and Janes and would not have been sent absent the $50,000 transfer. The arrangement allegedly allowed Hammond’s mail to be sent at less than 20 cents per piece – a cost advantage unavailable to Higgins, who paid standard rates because his campaign is not eligible for nonprofit postage discounts. Citizens for Higgins argues the conduct violates USPS Standard 1.6.10, which prohibits nonprofit mailings when a candidate or non-qualified entity pays for, prepares, or provides consideration for the mailing. The lawsuit seeks a declaratory judgment and court orders barring the practice from continuing. Party officials named in the lawsuit have not publicly responded to the allegations as of publication. Every one of us lives with tension - the tug-of-war between the two of us living in all of us. In DIVIDED, Pastor Jackson Lahmeyer gets real, raw, and deeply relatable as he opens up about his own struggles with pride, anger, and failure while chasing God's purpose. Through humor, honesty, and hard-learned wisdom, Lahmeyer invites readers to drop the mask, confront the "dark me" that keeps surfacing, and experience the transforming power of grace. This is not a polished preacher's pep talk-it's a gut-level, heart-to-heart conversation about what it means to follow Jesus when life gets messy. Drawing from the lives of biblical characters like Peter, Jacob and Paul, Lahmeyer shows that even the greatest heroes of faith had moments of weakness, doubt, and defeat. He unpacks the difference between remorse and repentance, explores how belief shapes behavior, and reveals how identity-not effort-is the key to lasting transformation. With vivid stories, relatable honesty, and the truth of Scripture, he reminds us that God isn't looking for the perfect version of you-He's after the real you. Because the moment you get real with God is the moment He starts making you new. If you've ever felt like you're living two lives-the public you that looks strong and the private you that's barely hanging on-this book is for you. DIVIDED will help you see that failure isn't final, temptation isn't sin, and your past doesn't disqualify your purpose. You'll laugh, you'll be challenged, and you'll find hope in the God who meets you where you are but never leaves you there. Honest, gritty, and full of grace, this book will inspire you to feed the right wolf, renew your mind, and finally live as the "you" God designed you to be.

Whether or not someone voted for you, every elected official should listen to their constituents’ hopes and dreams, and their struggles. Because listening to people and building relationships and understanding our common goals is the best way to bring some of them along with you. These days, that’s not what’s happening. With the midterm elections approaching, Donald Trump and the Republican party aren’t trying to persuade voters to see things their way — they’re trying to sidestep them altogether. The latest redistricting crisis started last summer when the White House persuaded Texas lawmakers to redraw the state's congressional map by dismantling districts where voters of color had been able to elect their candidate of choice. Missouri and North Carolina joined in, manipulating their own maps to try to steal enough seats to maintain control of the House of Representatives in the 2026 election.
And this fight is just beginning. At the start of this new year, several state legislatures are thinking about redrawing their maps to benefit Republicans. Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis announced the legislature would hold a special session this spring to make its current gerrymander even worse.
It’s on people like us to fight for fairness and to ensure that politicians are accountable to the people they were elected to serve.

Derek,
My name is Alex Vindman, and after a lot of discussion, I have made the decision to run for Florida’s United States Senate seat.
I hope you will give me a chance to explain — but if you already know the importance of winning in Florida, then I am asking you to split a Founding Donation between my campaign and Adam Schiff today.

Running for the United States Senate in Florida was not an easy decision. I knew the challenges going into this.
Ever since I blew the whistle on Donald Trump’s phone call with Ukraine, the president has had a vendetta against me. He attacks me every chance he gets on social media, and his billionaire allies will spend wherever it takes to pummel us in attack ads.
But as a former combat veteran in the United States Army, we don’t back down from a tough fight. We run towards it.
Our country is in chaos. While thug militias attack citizens and tariffs push prices sky-high, my opponent can’t seem to put public service before her own self-interest.
Ashley Moody screwed Florida homeowners by caving to the big insurance companies, supported this administration that gutted disaster help for communities trying to rebuild, and had over a million dollars in her corporate stock traded last year while she had access to insider information only Congress gets.
Ashley was hand-picked to be a ‘yes’ vote for Trump and the billionaire class. She is not Florida’s senator. She’s theirs.
So, that’s why I am running for the United States Senate. Because it’s time for us to make our voices heard and bring real leadership to Washington.
I know we can put Florida in play and save our democracy against an out-of-control president, but I cannot do it alone.

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | | When Jensen Huang Walked On Stage... | Peter,

Something really dangerous just happened — and it’s not getting nearly enough attention.

The EPA and Army Corps of Engineers just released a sweeping proposal to gut the Clean Water Act. They’re calling it an “update,” but let’s be honest: this is the biggest rollback of clean water protections in _**over 50 years.**_
---
| [FIGHT BACK ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/124371356/598393090/680287355?refcode=BLU_EM_MOSS_2026-01-30_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMTc5OTIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNmZiMTRhZWQtMDRmZS1mMDExLTgzMmYtMDAwZDNhMWYwZTRjIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Wnt_OcBPRAVguWjhf0gikKlT30v6P1wOL4kDutkllmg=)

Here’s what they want to do:

**❌** Strip protections from countless wetlands and streams across the country
**❌** Weaken the safeguards that keep pollution out of our drinking water
**❌** Make it easier for developers and big corporations to contaminate waterways with little oversight

They’re calling it the _**Polluted Water Rule,**_ and in Michigan, that’s a direct threat.

We are the Great Lakes State.

Our economy, our public health, our future — it all depends on clean water and protected wetlands. If this rollback happens, we’re looking at:

**💧** Water contamination
**🌊** Stormwater flooding
**🐟** Damage to fragile Great Lakes ecosystems

I’m running for Congress because Michigan needs leaders who will stand up to corporate polluters, protect our environment, and fight like hell to keep our water safe.

> Who would have ever thought that a Colorado suburb would be ground-zero for a violent community take-over by Venezuelan gang members. With a distance of 3,251 miles between Colorado and Caracas, how did these large numbers of Venezuelan gang members make their way to Aurora Colorado in the first place?
>
> If we start from the beginning, the answer is pretty simple; these folks were invited, enticed and eventually rewarded by the democrat-controlled sanctuary city of Denver. Upon the signing of the American Rescue Plan Act in 2021 (ARPA), the city of Denver immediately thrusted its hand out, declaring itself a "welcoming city" for illegal immigrants.

> This declaration allowed the city of Denver to receive billions of ARPA dollars from the Biden/Harris administration, which it used to launch its Emergency Migrant Response Resettlement Program. In turn, the city of Denver recruited several local non-governmental organizations (NGOs), to provide housing and humanitarian services for more than 10,000 illegal Venezuelan migrants, thus publicly subsidizing illegal immigration from a country hostile to the United States.
>
> To make matters worse, if that were possible, a large majority of these Venezuelan migrants have been identified as having ties to the violent and deadly prison gang, Tren-de-Aragua (TdA). These gang members were placed in apartments (at taxpayer expense of course), in the Denver suburb of Aurora, and began to set up their violent criminal enterprise.
>
> Tren-de-Aragua began as a prison gang in Venezuela and has quickly expanded its reach into major metropolitan cities across the United States the last three years, due to the Biden/Harris open border catch and release policy. The gang is known for being especially violent, with its main exploits being extortion and trafficking in women and children for sexual exploitation.
>
> Almost immediately, the apartments saw a dramatic rise in crimes against its current residents, ranging from simple theft to sexual assaults on minors. The gang began using the apartments as a hub for its extortion and human trafficking rings. The current tenants had now become hostages within their own building, as armed gang members had commandeered the three-unit complex.
>
> The mainstream media and the local democrat establishment went right to work trying to dispel and quash the goings-on at the Aurora apartment complex, calling anyone racist or xenophobic for speaking out. Aurora city councilmember Dannielle Jurinsky tweeted "gangs have taken over the complex", after viewing the viral video footage of illegal Venezuelan immigrants with long guns patrolling the stairwells of the apartment complex.
>
> A Denver law firm was hired by the mayor's office to investigate the apparent siege of the apartment complex, which began over a year ago. According to the mayor's office, they concluded tenants were fleeing the Whispering Pines Apartments in massive numbers in early 2024, due the massive increase in crimes against its residents.
>
> The report went on to state "The evidence we have reviewed indicates that gang members are engaging in flagrant trespass violations, assaults and battery, human trafficking and sexual abuse of minors, unlawful firearms possession, extortion, and other criminal activities, often targeting vulnerable Venezuelan and other immigrant populations," wrote Markus Funk, a former U.S. Attorney.
>
> Democrat legislators throughout the state continue to blame the apartment's managers for the crime wave and called the residents claims, "isolated incidents," despite knowing the investigations findings. Unfortunately for the residents, this is the new normal democrats have promised them; and don't forget the bonus, if you speak out or complain, you're xenophobic.
>
> Thanks, and God bless you.

Dear _Flyover_ Reader, **I 've never sent an email like this one.** This is a personal note -- just for our most loyal readers -- and I'm sending it because tomorrow is the final day to invest in _The Flyover_. Not days from now. Only hours. By the time you read this, there will likely be fewer than 200 investor spots left. When they're gone, this round closes -- permanently. I want to be very honest about why we've been pushing so hard these past few months - and ask you to consider investing in the final hours. [Invest here.](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyskbFu4zAMhp9G3hJIlCM7g4bDGZ4ul6VAR0GWqFitLAc27SBvX7hN0KVj54_8QP7_68mcbEwxX_7bATWF0Xj00VlCbzLe5oREOJm4YsYVpxkz2YyDjSnFd6TeAAe142InufnbhiWl730QhdcBEVAWqEWljtVRAUDRa-BCdAjcibI-qK6yFkLwzqJyZejKuoh6E3Mhuai5lId9jU6F8qgCurpWnWQlRx9pnPZvY8zUY0j3ccVp78ahSLonus5M_mHQMmhjXnGmHyY3LNuFBjOPy-SQyaZ53s9AbWBAH5eByeZ8y-h3J_TRPpCzw9XGS2ayab-cTzBmwkxMNtDY-_wPAz0I4bS5XtpzI42QHFQxaX-9bXnOqmIlv2zhfn5Bv9_HquEjAAD__7noqi0) The simple reason is this: I want to partner with you -- readers of _The Flyover_ -- more than anyone else who is legally allowed to invest. Whether you read our national edition, one of our state editions, listen to _The Flyover Podcast_ , or love reading the _Feel Good Flyover_ -- you are who I want on our cap table. **Let me briefly explain why this matters so much to me.** **First: We 've built something extremely rare.**
In just over two years, _The Flyover_ has grown faster than any news publication we're aware of -- and unlike most, we've already reached profitability. Our margins are strong and the flywheel is working. Most media startups never get here. We did -- and now we're ready to scale. **Second: This capital is for expansion.**
We're not raising money just to raise it. Your investment goes directly toward growth: expanding into more states, scaling our podcasts -this month we will reach one million monthly viewers/listeners! -- and building new ways to meet readers where they are -- from texting to apps and beyond. **But the real reason is this:****I want our readers to be our owners.** Yes, this round is legally open to others. But we are pushing hard to our readers, intentionally front-loading perks and bonus shares so that readers have had the first and best opportunity to invest. Once this round closes, that window shuts -- and future investors will not get the same terms. That's why we've been pushing hard.
Not for hype.
Not for optics.
But because this is the moment for readers to become partners. **We 're in the final stretch now. **Hours left. Fewer than 200 spots. One closing bell. So I'll ask you directly -- founder to reader: Will you consider being one of our final investors? If yes, I'd be honored to have you with us. Invest in _The Flyover_ before the round closes: [https://theflyover.com/invest](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyskbFu4zAMhp9G3hJIlCM7g4bDGZ4ul6VAR0GWqFitLAc27SBvX7hN0KVj54_8QP7_68mcbEwxX_7bATWF0Xj00VlCbzLe5oREOJm4YsYVpxkz2YyDjSnFd6TeAAe142InufnbhiWl730QhdcBEVAWqEWljtVRAUDRa-BCdAjcibI-qK6yFkLwzqJyZejKuoh6E3Mhuai5lId9jU6F8qgCurpWnWQlRx9pnPZvY8zUY0j3ccVp78ahSLonus5M_mHQMmhjXnGmHyY3LNuFBjOPy-SQyaZ53s9AbWBAH5eByeZ8y-h3J_TRPpCzw9XGS2ayab-cTzBmwkxMNtDY-_wPAz0I4bS5XtpzI42QHFQxaX-9bXnOqmIlv2zhfn5Bv9_HquEjAAD__7noqi0) Thank you for reading. Thank you for believing. And thank you for helping us build something rare. Sincerely,
Guy Short
Founder,_The Flyover_

body:
The Trump agenda is exhausting by design, and Americans are tired.
Peter,

The Trump agenda is exhausting by design, and Americans are tired.

Every day, we're forced to keep up with a new headline, a new tragedy, a new threat — all while trying to live our lives, do our jobs, and take care of our families.

_Nothing is off limits._

Trump is cutting guaranteed, already-spent funding for states including Kentucky; he is using the Department of Justice as a political weapon, prioritizing personal vendettas over the needs of everyday people; and he is dispatching federal agents across the country to terrorize communities and sow chaos.

And Republicans up and down the ballot are doing nothing to stop it — **even when these actions hurt their own constituents back home.**

Peter, people are tired of the circus, but if Republicans keep control of Congress for two more years, this chaos will continue to be the norm, and Americans will be completely worn down by a government that doesn't listen and doesn't care. We should be able to trust our leaders. We should feel confident that our government is working for us, not against us, so we can get up, go to work, raise our families, and believe that someone in Washington has our backs.

**[That's the leadership In This Together PAC is fighting for. clean_body: Results from my work in Congress | | | | It is an honor to represent the 2nd District. Our shared values – working hard, caring for each other, and serving the community – guide my work in Congress. My role as your representative is to work for you, listen to your concerns, and stand up against the Republican Rip-off. As Northwest Washington recovers from last month's severe flooding, I am working closely with local and federal leaders to make sure our communities get the aid they need. Last week, I joined Washington state's entire congressional delegation to request that the Trump administration unlock $21.3 million in federal FEMA resources for families whose homes were destroyed or significantly damaged in the extreme flooding that hit our state in December. I also worked to secure the reinstatement of nearly $2 billion in funding to help fight the opioid crisis, including seven grants here in Washington. I worked with Democrats and Republicans to demand that the Trump administration reverse its reckless and dangerous decision to cancel critical funding. I am glad the administration caved quickly, and I remain committed to supporting local efforts to combat the opioid epidemic and save lives. = I have also spent the last few weeks meeting with important community organizations and stakeholders to ensure we are laying the groundwork to win big this year. Thank you to the Snohomish County, San Juan County, Skagit County, Whatcom County, the 42nd Legislative District Democrats, and Washington State Democrats for their lively engagement and thoughtful questions.
