clean_body: One day a week. | | | | | Fellow Patriot, | | Charlie Kirk built a movement for truth -- but his final message pointed to something eternal. It wasn't about politics... or elections... or even about the culture war. His final book was deeply personal, and unlike anything Charlie had written before... It was about the Sabbath. About sacred rest. Reconnecting with God. Charlie wrote this book because he knew what America was missing... and what he nearly lost himself. He found that in a world addicted to busyness, noise, and scrolling... The most radical act of resistance is to STOP. To rest. To reflect. To return to God. This book is his blueprint for how we do that -- as individuals, as families, and as a nation. 🔥 You'll discover how Charlie learned to honor the Sabbath in a culture that never stops 🔥 How setting aside just one day a week gave him clarity, peace, and strength 🔥 Why he believed this message could spark a spiritual revival across America I know he would've wanted you to have this book. When you give today to Turning Point USA, you 're not just supporting the movement Charlie built -- you're helping pass on the message he felt most urgently in his final months. Fellow Patriot, thank you, in advance, for helping reach the next generation with truth, faith, and moral courage -- the very things Charlie gave his life for. And as you do, may the message of this book lead you -- just as it led Charlie -- to a deeper trust in God, a stronger love for your family, and a renewed peace in your own soul. For Charlie, Justin Streiff Chief Operating Officer Turning Point USA P.S. Charlie Kirk's final book, Stop, in the Name of God, is a heartfelt call to slow down, remember what's eternal, and rest in God. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

# Trump taps Warsh to overhaul Fed leadership
President Trump on Friday **[nominated former Fed Governor Kevin Warsh](https://substack.com/redirect/9fec14aa-3d90-4bed-a77e-4a24fe069b7a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to replace Jerome Powell as Federal Reserve chair, capping months of turmoil and pressure for lower interest rates ahead of Powell's May term end.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9fec14aa-3d90-4bed-a77e-4a24fe069b7a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Former Fed insider chosen:** Kevin Warsh, 55, served as a Federal Reserve governor from 2006-2011 and is seen by markets as credible with Wall Street ties, unlikely to fully bend to political demands.
* **Contentious selection process:** Trump ended a five-month search involving interviews of finalists like Christopher Waller and Rick Rieder by Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, praising all candidates' potential.
* **Policy shift signaled:** Warsh previously called for a "regime change" at the Fed and criticized incumbents' credibility, amid ongoing debates over Fed independence and Trump's push for aggressive rate cuts.
* **Senate hurdles loom:** Some Republicans like Sen. Thom Tillis vow to block confirmation until a DOJ probe into Powell resolves, while others praise Warsh's monetary policy expertise.

# Precious metals crash gold dives below $5000
Gold plunged as much as 7% below $5000 an ounce Friday while silver tumbled over 13% shedding double-digit gains as **[a blistering rally in precious metals abruptly halted](https://substack.com/redirect/7083a7c1-38cc-48ea-ac0c-8a87e4d4b945?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** triggered by reports of Kevin Warsh's nomination as Federal Reserve chair strengthening the dollar and easing debasement fears.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7083a7c1-38cc-48ea-ac0c-8a87e4d4b945?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Rally reversal hits hard:** Gold futures dropped around 6% to near $5000 per ounce and silver plunged 13% toward $100 after recent record highs above $5500 and $120 respectively.
* **Dollar boost drives selloff:** Reports of Trump preparing to nominate Kevin Warsh for Fed chair lifted the dollar curbing the appeal of precious metals as a hedge against currency weakness.
* **Profit-taking intensifies losses:** Investors locked in gains after gold's 80%+ yearly surge and silver's even sharper rise leading to wild swings and broad metals market pullback.
* **Market outlook shifts dramatically:** The sharp correction raises questions about rally sustainability with analysts noting overshot prices and stretched technical indicators signaling potential further volatility.
* **Broader Metals Sell-Off:** Copper dropped over 3% after surging, platinum tumbled more than 10%, spreading the correction across industrial and precious sectors.

* **Extreme Volatility Hits Metals:** Silver suffered its steepest drop in years with over 17% decline, while gold fell as much as 8% amid overbought signals like RSI at 90.
* **Rally Remains Strong Overall:** Despite sharp pullback, gold up 17% in January and silver nearly 40% year-to-date, highlighting risks in parabolic moves.

# Panama boots China-linked ports operator in "Donroe Doctrine" win
Panama's Supreme Court voided a Hong Kong-based CK Hutchison subsidiary's concession to **[operate key ports at both ends of the Panama Canal](https://substack.com/redirect/4019eb1a-5883-42ee-a85f-cd8137ab73d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Thursday, delivering a major win for President Trump's push to curb Chinese influence over the vital trade route.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4019eb1a-5883-42ee-a85f-cd8137ab73d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Court strikes concession:** Panama's top court declared the Panama Ports Company contract unconstitutional, invalidating operations at Balboa and Cristobal ports since the 1990s.
* **Trump claims victory:** The ruling bolsters Trump's administration efforts to counter perceived Chinese sway, following his threats to reclaim the canal under a new "Donroe Doctrine."
* **Stock impact hits hard:** CK Hutchison shares plunged nearly 5% in Hong Kong trading as uncertainty grows over its stalled $23 billion global ports sale to a BlackRock-led group.
* **China vows defense:** Beijing condemned the decision as unlawful and pledged all necessary measures, including legal action, to protect its companies' rights and interests in the region.

# Chevron beats earnings despite oil crash, as record production soars and Venezuela boom looms
Chevron reported fourth-quarter 2025 adjusted earnings of $1.52 per share, **[surpassing Wall Street expectations,](https://substack.com/redirect/bc82c95a-cab0-43e1-a2f1-9412039f90fb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as record oil production--including a 21% quarterly surge--offset sharply lower crude prices amid the biggest annual oil drop since 2020. The company highlighted major upside potential from expanded operations in Venezuela following recent U.S. intervention.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5926f044-8780-49a3-8a59-0bdf5e3ae968?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Record Output Achieved** : Chevron pumped 4.05 million barrels of oil equivalent per day in Q4, up 21% year-over-year, driving global production to all-time highs and U.S. output up 16% for the full year.
* **Venezuela Expansion Planned** : The company expects to ramp up Venezuelan production by 50% over the next 18-24 months, positioning it uniquely among U.S. majors after U.S. seizure of assets and Maduro's capture.
* **Dividend Hike Announced** : Quarterly dividend increased 4% to $1.78 per share, with $6.4 billion in total shareholder distributions during the quarter despite profit declines.
* **Lower Prices Hit Revenue** : Revenue fell 10% to $46.87 billion, missing estimates, while net income dropped 14% to $2.77 billion, pressured by weak crude markets but cushioned by cost efficiencies.

* * *
* * *
# NYC Instacart shoppers horrified by new "Regulatory Response Fee" as new law takes effect
Instacart has added a $5.99 "Regulatory Response Fee" to New York City grocery orders this week **[after a new city law took effect,](https://substack.com/redirect/cb3d1721-49a3-4059-9a44-6adcd3fff82d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** requiring app-based delivery workers to earn at least $21.44 per hour. The company blames the mandate for raising operating costs, prompting backlash from frustrated customers facing higher prices amid strained budgets.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cb3d1721-49a3-4059-9a44-6adcd3fff82d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Worker Pay Boost:** New York City law guarantees grocery delivery couriers a minimum of $21.44 per hour excluding tips, aligning with restaurant delivery rates and rising to $22.13 by April due to inflation.
* **Tipping Rule Change:** Platforms must now offer tipping options before checkout with a 10% default, addressing past practices that hid prompts and cost workers over $550 million in lost income.
* **Fee Implementation Details:** The fixed $5.99 surcharge appears at checkout for NYC orders, explicitly to offset increased costs from government regulations on delivery platforms.
* **Customer Backlash Grows:** Shoppers criticize the charge as excessive on social media, with some threatening or proceeding to cancel memberships over added costs during tough economic times.

This Monday evening, I'm giving a talk in Pittsburgh about Faith and Democracy, a course I developed at Duquesne Law School. I'll talk about the role faith played in politics for me, including after I was beaten so badly in 2022 that plenty of people, at times myself included, thought my political life was over. I'll also introduce some of the texts and thinkers who helped me make sense of my experience and draw inspiration to stay involved.
You can sign up to watch online or in-person [here](https://substack.com/redirect/025f60bc-b657-4fca-b290-fd6ebeca41da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). If the video quality is decent enough, I'll try to send it out afterward.
If you're part of any groups that would appreciate a talk like this, feel free to get in touch or let me know in the replies to this post. I think a more regular conversation about faith and our "small-d" democracy would be beneficial. name: AOC
subject: I refuse to give up.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
That's not a life.
#
If we do not assert ourselves and enshrine our rights — and demand healthcare, and education, and dignity — the alternative is barbarism, which is what we are contending with now.
The fact that people are choosing between medicine and rent is barbarism.
The fact that people are worried about whether they will be on the streets every 4 weeks is barbarism.
The fact that every time a person has an ache or a pain, and they’re scared that it could either be a sore joint or cancer, but they can’t find out because they can’t afford the doctor? **This is barbarism.**
If we do not demand — and not only demand, but win — unions, healthcare, wages, and ending endless war, then we will condemn ourselves to barbarism.
I refuse to give up. I refuse to submit myself to that future. That’s not a life.
**And so to live, we have to fight for each other. We have to stand with each other. We have to fight for this vision and this world.**
[If you can, will you make a $5 contribution – or any amount that is meaningful to you – to help power our fight for transformative change? But here we are -- in a special election that will determine who speaks for us in Congress at a moment when our democracy, our economy, and our basic sense of decency are all under strain. I'm running to replace Marjorie Taylor Greene because I've spent my life in service -- not chasing headlines, not serving special interests, but standing up for people who've been ignored for far too long.

body:
We already rejected MAGA talking points in New Hampshire. Now national Republicans are dusting off their playbook.
# [](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1&akid=4863%2E582294%2Espe2ZF)
**I’m sorry about Karoline Leavitt.**
A few years ago, Karoline Leavitt ran against me for Congress here in New Hampshire. Her campaign was steeped in extreme MAGA rhetoric and zero connection to the actual issues Granite Staters face every day. **Voters saw right through it and rejected her agenda by nearly 10 points.**
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260130_1.jg2pBn&refcode=em20260130-1&t=2&akid=4863%2E582294%2Espe2ZF)
Unfortunately that race turned into a national audition. Now the same talking points and spin that New Hampshire voters dismissed are being used daily from the White House briefing room.
So if you’re wondering how the rest of the country ended up having to listen to Karoline Leavitt, it’s because New Hampshire proved something important first: Her extreme ideas don’t hold up when you put them in front of real voters.
But that hasn’t stopped the MAGA machine from trying. **National Republicans are pouring money into New Hampshire because they think they can break through and notch a win here to cling to their Senate majority.** They’ve lined up behind John Sununu, an NRSC-backed candidate who will vote with Donald Trump and MAGA leadership when it matters most. It’s a new candidate reading from the same old playbook.
I’ve beaten their playbook before by focusing on kitchen-table issues, standing up for families, and telling the truth. **[Now I need your help to do it again. Will you chip in $5 before tomorrow’s end-of-month deadline to help us keep this Senate seat blue and fight on what matters to Granite Staters?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260130_1.jg2pBn&refcode=em20260130-1&t=3&akid=4863%2E582294%2Espe2ZF)**
Granite Staters value independence. They reward common sense. And they don’t like being sold a script written somewhere else.
If you believe New Hampshire should keep leading the way and showing the rest of the country that MAGA politics don’t work here, I’m asking you to be a part of our campaign. **If Democrats are going to flip the Senate, we need to win this open race in New Hampshire.**
**[Will you chip in before our deadline tomorrow to help us keep this Senate seat blue and stop national Republicans from installing another vote for Trump’s agenda?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260130_1.jg2pBn&refcode=em20260130-1&t=4&akid=4863%2E582294%2Espe2ZF)**

Thanks for being in this fight with me.
Chris

body:
The lawsuit the Supreme Court agreed to hear isn't about fairness. It's not about so-called "election integrity," because millions of taxpayers' dollars have been wasted on state investigations looking for mail-in ballot fraud that simply does not exist.
This lawsuit is a political ploy to suppress legitimate mail-in ballots that are postmarked by Election Day and potentially delayed by the U.S. Postal Service. This lawsuit targets our fellow citizens who have done nothing wrong and might have their vote suppressed through delays out of their control. And it's all because the political party that brought the lawsuit knows that those delayed ballots are more likely to have been cast by voters for the other party and not themselves.
We cannot let anyone get away with such a cynical attempt at hidden voter suppression, no matter who controls the Supreme Court. RUSH $35 or more right now to help us spread the word about this lawsuit and defend the right to vote across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=013026_2&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
DemocracyDocket: SCOTUS to Hear GOP Lawsuit That Could Radically Restrict Mail Voting [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=013026_2&amount=25]
Team: Mail-in ballots are under attack again.
The Supreme Court agreed to hear arguments in RNC v. Wetzel, a lawsuit challenging Mississippi’s law allowing a five-day grace period for late-arriving ballots mailed by Election Day. In simpler terms, it's a case about whether your vote will count if you mail it on or before Election Day, but your ballot arrives after Election Day.
It's clear why a political party -- in this case, the Republican National Committee (RNC) -- is claiming that states must reject ballots that arrive after Election Day. Doing so would potentially disenfranchise a large number of voters, restricting the number of participants in an election. And the data is clear, over the last several election cycles, Republicans have been outnumbered in the use of mail-in ballots.
The RNC is making a blunt decision that their ability to win elections matters more than your vote. It's a cynical attempt to stay in power by suppressing ballots that are delivered late by the postal service. It's the kind of partisan work that shows they'd rather believe in their own power and control than the principles of democracy, of a country where all our votes should count, regardless of party.

Our position is clear: If your ballot was postmarked by Election Day, it should count.
This shouldn't be a partisan question. No political party -- Democrat, Republican, Green, Working Families, Libertarian, Reform, Conservative -- should be against voting. No party in our democracy should want to restrict the fundamental right of our fellow citizens to make their voice heard through voting.
But now we're facing a case where the Supreme Court’s decision could strike down or uphold laws in 16 states (and Washington D.C.) allowing late-arriving ballots postmarked on or before Election Day to be counted if they arrive within a set grace period.
How do we know what is at stake? Data from the 2024 Massachusetts elections shows that their three-day grace period for ballots to arrive after Election Day resulted in a 60% drop in rejected ballots as compared to no grace period. I’m not going to sugar coat it — Minnesota has been through a lot.

The killings of two innocent Minnesotans. Three thousand ICE agents on our streets and in our towns, sent by an administration that relishes division. Minnesotans stood up. Our state has been the center of America’s heartbreak. But we have also been the center of America's courage and America's hope. In moments of enormous difficulty, we find strength in our Minnesota values of hard work, freedom, and simple decency and good will.

**These moments call for grit and resilience.** I’ve learned resilience from the people of Minnesota. They have stood up, they have marched, and they have brought food to their neighbors. Through it all we do not give up.

My grandpa worked 1500 feet underground in the mines on the Iron Range, and he saved his money in a coffee can in the basement to send my dad to college. I wouldn’t be where I am today without them.

**I will do my job without fear or favor. I’ve never shied away from taking on the powerful. That’s what I did as a prosecutor. That’s what I did as senator. And that’s what I will do as your governor.**

I believe we must stand up for what’s right. And fix what’s wrong. I am running for every Minnesotan who wants to buy their first home, for every parent who wants a better world for their kids, for everyone who wants more affordable healthcare. I am running for every Minnesotan who wants to protect our democracy and get ICE and its abusive tactics out of the state we love.

And I'm running for every student, farmer, dreamer and builder.

_But to accomplish everything we’re setting out to do, I need your support._

**This campaign is for people who believe in something bigger than ourselves. For people who know that things have got to change.**

I was ranked number one in the Senate for bipartisan bills and number three out of one hundred for getting bills passed into law. I will do my job without fear or favor. I’ve never shied away from taking on the powerful. That’s what I did as a prosecutor. That’s what I did as senator. And that’s what I will do as your governor. I believe we must stand up for what’s right. And fix what’s wrong. I am running for every Minnesotan who wants to buy their first home, for every parent who wants a better world for their kids, for everyone who wants more affordable healthcare. I am running for every Minnesotan who wants to protect our democracy and get ICE and its abusive tactics out of the state we love. And I'm running for every student, farmer, dreamer and builder. Look, I keep fighting in court because no one harms Coloradans on my watch.
When Trump attacked Coloradans’ access to SNAP, he didn’t only threaten the 600,000 people — including nearly half of SNAP recipient households with children — who receive those benefits so they can afford to pay for food. _He attacked all of us._
These callous cuts are harming Coloradans. As Colorado State University estimated, **cutting SNAP by just 20% would damage our state’s economy to the tune of $35 million.** Taking food away from vulnerable Coloradans is wrong; in Colorado, we believe that we all must look out for one another. When some of us are harmed, we all are.
It’s another reason that fighting for Colorado — as your attorney general today, and soon as your next governor — is so important to me.

subject: Charlie wrote this for the soul
body:
[unsubscribe](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?xul=1nmc5a54x67zfmd5fi2bt1ih25mnb9jnlpja72pep634drpalkma5t7gsx41zemwnbec97mprzfy2k08yx7ky4qfkahsso203rnpp59073qyfuzvgofx&__stmp=t9oznj&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh)
Please read the message below from our sponsor.

Steve Thompson, Editor
* * *

| | | [](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9oznj&__onlt=h)
---
| | Friend,
---
| | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn’t a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal — the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God’s grace.**

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**“God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.”**_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.
---
[](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9oznj&__onlt=h)
---
When you read it, you will hear Charlie’s voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family.

Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

**[To claim your copy of this life-changing book, simply make a generous gift in any amount to Turning Point USA today.](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9oznj&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9oznj&__onlt=h)
---
In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans...

...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — _**it’s the message of FAITH!**_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. _And it’s happening._

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we’re witnessing is not just growth —**it’s revival.**

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families.

We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message.

You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie.

**But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up.**

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, _“We’re not backing down.”_

This is what Charlie prayed for.

I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too.

None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, **_so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith._**

Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God.

**[To claim your copy of Charlie’s final book, simply make a gift, in any amount, to support Turning Point USA today.](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9oznj&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9oznj&__onlt=h)
---
I’ll personally ensure your copy is sent to you as soon as possible.

Thank you in advance for carrying on Charlie’s mission and supporting his legacy.
---
**For Charlie,**

**Justin Streiff**
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point USA

[](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9oznj&__onlt=h)

---
**P.S.** When you read **_Stop, in the Name of God,_** you will discover what Charlie found in the Sabbath: a holy rest that steadies the heart, renews the soul, and gives strength for the road ahead.

**[I hope you’ll claim your copy by making your most generous gift to Turning Point USA. Your support fuels our work to build the most faithful generation of Americans in history. https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-26q1?refcode=x_260130_abolishice4_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-26q1?refcode=x_260130_abolishice4_act]
People in Missouri and across the country are scared—and our leaders are failing us.
TODAY, as ICE protests erupt nationwide demanding real accountability , some Democrats are offering half-measures: calling ICE “improperly trained” while quietly voting to give the agency even more money.
Cori’s opponent is one of them. His vote to thank and give “gratitude” to ICE isn’t just a bad call—it’s a betrayal of families in St. Louis and across the country who are being terrorized by a rogue agency.
Cori would never vote to support ICE. In fact, she’s been calling to abolish ICE for years. She is prepared to meet this moment, but she needs you with her. Can you join Cori by signing this petition to show the forces of hate and division that we won't back down? [https://secure.ngpvan.com/4qRlc8gFxUy7i7fuM0mE1w2]
IT'S TIME TO ABOLISH ICE [https://secure.ngpvan.com/4qRlc8gFxUy7i7fuM0mE1w2]
What happened to Renée Nicole Good, Alex Pretti, and Keith Porter, Jr. was a tragedy. So were the countless other tragic ICE-related attacks that have been swept under the rug by a deceitful and dangerous administration. If our leaders refuse to act, this will happen again.
Our communities shouldn’t have to live in fear. Our neighbors shouldn’t have to wonder if they or their children could be next. And we will not let someone hold a seat in Congress while standing against the people and values of Missouri.
Right now, millions of people across the country are demanding real accountability: Congress must act immediately to abolish ICE, and Trump and his fascist agents must be held responsible for the harm they’ve caused.
Will you join us? Add your name to our petition right now to demand that Congress take immediate action to abolish ICE. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/4qRlc8gFxUy7i7fuM0mE1w2]
We need a fighter in Congress, someone who will stand up to Trump, end ICE’s reign of terror, and build an immigration system rooted in justice and humanity. That fighter is Cori.

Here’s Cori in action, standing with St. Louis families at an ICE protest.
If you can, please consider donating to help elect Cori and fight back against extremist forces like ICE, AIPAC, and others trying to tear our communities apart. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-26q1?refcode=x_260130_abolishice4_act]

Stay safe today, and thank you for showing up for justice.
In solidarity,
Team Cori

name: Mai Vang
subject: I’m ready to step into the ring and fight for CA-07
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Justice Democrats
body:
I know what it takes to stretch a paycheck and build a life.
#
[](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260130-mv.SO-lUO&refcode=em20260130-37415&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=37415%2E1203867%2EFNlfoJ)
Peter,
This is Mai Vang, Sacramento City Councilmember and candidate for Congress in California’s 7th district. **I’m deeply honored to receive the endorsement of Justice Democrats.**
In a moment, **[I’m going to ask if you’ll chip in to my primary campaign against a 20-year incumbent deep in the pockets of corporate PACs,](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260130-mv.SO-lUO&refcode=em20260130-37415&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=37415%2E1203867%2EFNlfoJ)** but first, let me tell you why I’m taking her on.
I’m the daughter of Hmong refugees, a Sacramento native, and the eldest of 16 kids. I know what it takes to stretch a paycheck and build a life.
**When you don’t have money, you fight for everything you have – and for everything your community deserves to survive and thrive.** I’ve been a fighter my entire life, and I won’t stop fighting for Sacramento’s working families in the halls of Congress.
_We are living through a crisis._ Our neighbors are being ripped from their families by ICE. Working people can't afford rent, healthcare, or groceries. And too many establishment Democrats in Washington — including Rep. Doris Matsui — are more concerned with protecting the status quo than protecting our people.
**We need leaders in Congress who will meet this moment with the courage it demands** — leaders who fight because it's right, not because they're finally being held accountable. We can't wait for another election cycle of empty promises. We need leaders who will step into the ring and fight _today._
Unlike our current representative:
* I don’t take a penny from billionaires, corporate PACs, or AIPAC.
* I will put working people before the billionaires and corporate interests standing in the way of affordable housing, healthcare, and more.
* I will protect our communities from the violent terror of Trump’s secret police force by voting to defund and abolish ICE.

I’ve delivered real results for families and students as a member of the Sacramento school board and city council. Now, I’m ready to join Justice Democrats’ bloc of working-class, progressive leaders in Congress willing to fight for the bold change we so desperately and urgently deserve.
**But since this campaign is 100% people-powered, I’m going to need a groundswell of grassroots support to take on a powerful incumbent in less than six months.**
**[Please, split a contribution of any amount to Justice Democrats and my campaign today to rapidly build the resources needed to win this primary →](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260130-mv.SO-lUO&refcode=em20260130-37415&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=37415%2E1203867%2EFNlfoJ)**
**[Contribute $5](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260130-mv.SO-lUO&refcode=em20260130-37415&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=23&akid=37415%2E1203867%2EFNlfoJ)**
Thank you for your support,
Mai

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20260130-37415-footer&t=24&refcode2=37415_1203867_FNlfoJ&akid=37415%2E1203867%2EFNlfoJ)**

## Trump accounts invest in America...
This week, Trump unveiled Trump Accounts: a new program that invests money into the next generation.
I think it's one of the most brilliant moves he's made.
In a nutshell, under this program the government will invest $1,000 into tax-advantaged investment accounts for every American child born between January 2025 and December 31 2028.
Per the [IRS](https://substack.com/redirect/1235d3ea-0327-47a0-b692-ff88f640976f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Trump Accounts are designed to "give the next generation a jump start on saving"
But these aren't the "baby bonds" of the 20th century, and it's definitely not social security.
Trump accounts "allow for private ownership, multiple funding pathways, and direct investment across a broad swath of the American economy," according to Secretary of the Treasury Scott Bessent.
So what can we expect from Trump Accounts looking ahead to the future?

# Our Path to Victory
---
| | Dear friends,
I want to be very clear about why I’m confident this campaign can win.
I’m a Bernie Democrat. I’m challenging an establishment incumbent who represents the politics of yesterday - siding with war funding, corporate interests, and a status quo that leaves too many people behind.
Our path to victory is simple: **Re-engage, reconnect, and re-energize the progressive and working-class base in California’s 2nd District.**
In the 2016 Democratic primary, Bernie carried all counties in District 2 except one. He also carried the newly added counties of Modoc, Shasta, and Siskiyou. That base didn’t disappear. It was ignored.
Our campaign is built to bring those voters back with priorities that resonate:
* Medicare for All
* Housing as a human right
* Climate resilience
* Peace and diplomacy over endless war

Today, people across the country are calling for action to abolish ICE and to reject a system that prioritizes militarization over human needs. That same moral urgency is at the heart of this campaign.
I need your help to turn this strategy into reality:

Peter,

Real change doesn’t happen by waiting for someone else to act — it happens
when we come together and make our voices heard. And right now, we’re
seeing that power in action.

Take this win: Avelo Airlines had a government contract to operate
deportation flights for ICE. After sustained pressure from organizers,
activists, and everyday people refusing to stay silent, the company pulled
out of the contract completely.

Here’s another: In Minneapolis, workers successfully pressured a local
hotel to stop renting rooms to ICE agents during their violent occupation
of the city.

That wasn’t luck — that was the power of collective action. It was people
speaking up, demanding accountability, and refusing to let injustice
slide.

This is exactly why the Squad Victory Fund exists: to make sure our
progressive leadership stays in power, fighting for the communities that
need it most.

Together, we can push back against ICE, fight the militarization of our
streets, and demand justice for people too often ignored by those in
power. Every call made, every message sent, every action taken builds the
kind of movement that decision-makers can’t ignore.

With the end-of-month deadline coming up, now is the moment to double
down. Momentum only grows when we all show up, stay engaged, and make it
clear that we won’t back down.

body:
Democrats are outspending Republicans by historic margins across the country, in races that wouldn’t have been considered battleground races just a few years ago. |
---
Fellow American,

I know this is the time you start receiving a lot of emails about the first End-of-Month fundraising deadline of 2026. Most of the emails will tell you it's an important deadline, but they will rarely explain why these End-of-Month deadlines are so critical to a campaign's success.

**That's why I wanted to take a minute to break down why our Saturday deadline is so important and not just a marketing gimmick.** After you hear my explanation, I hope you'll join our fight by pitching in a few dollars ahead of January 31st.

Democrats are outspending Republicans by historic margins across the country, in races that wouldn't have been considered battleground races just a few years ago. They're relying on a radical base of megadonors and extremist special interest groups to fuel their campaigns.

We don't have their base of extremist megadonors. We're a grassroots-powered campaign. That means, to compete, every ad and voter outreach campaign needs to be carefully planned, budgeted for, and executed. That's where our End-of-Month fundraising deadlines come into play - _especially the first of the Election Year._

Months in advance, my campaign team sets specific monthly fundraising benchmarks to run the ads and target the voters we need to secure victory. These fundraising targets allow my team to plan our winning voter outreach strategy and combat anything the Democrats throw at us.

In a race this expensive and contentious, **[every End-of-Month fundraising deadline counts.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=648732c2295b44519710785eda175d09&_e=jp5sO2c2IBKmQ2g-9naDpozyzNpZAl9sRt5lg9q6q_le-I--6hK9Jznn6ifRBz2x50z-p5g9Tx2vT3CSu8TgMDAMF5SYzpt29oAJP6-UXd7GoeVp2IniJ0189DYRDV-OX3eJY3M3n8sUCU1egefGuG0WTEzQGu_O4YINvkQLB6T7I2dxr0AvqAprPac0c3OSSlz15bzDtETYlCFgrLYGQmvHbtyFn4PLEEe5NqK6eZ9maKWco-9RINxYvRhUakCNXBLXhzVD2pX2eEYhXu3ZCLcrbhmdC5EJKD8g15U4SS3PFiKtRLpVxex_hNXxdErZl5XhlMDdSOj-t0ZGVe9MF5udobRZi3fHqXqAIlafkDyKLmIEk8D6KXJWc9ORiG3ERmkuAOvQcJAV-Kmxi_F4ZcGtNAKxx3pgvEqmj-An0utKyzI_im8ms6fazr5bG7AqEwfvYZ8LRBM49j_wTTGnVbbtyMeOY9z6I1V21IE_eizeu1HKGTjtaJofkSnht4fcxBjBHPJ-sJicJnrPTTswNU9Hka1bQDHzPtccUilf2UUOY7f5JFYnfCNnAVpzipUl9T8kjqcjp2vQd1IXErPd_HYxX2b8cASLkjJDSaeBKuSg50Qq_ADtgOibn3mH3lZDA2RIL6J3xb-uKX2ezwp5d1SscWFX2vnaC0WYOdYIDRciySi2niZdl4FauSzvczO1JdJFSYALXZM7zGo9GxtEk0UdFfNkAHRV06QqJJSXlZGT6GJoJt6fN3N50vgnJV2x)** One down month or a missed deadline could permanently put us on the defensive, jeopardizing our Republican majority.

| | | | | [](https://6s79z9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001RRKh1e2MaVR4TzXPSiBVY159FbB_ycv5oexFsKBGqjGiaYUV8dVJ3WLQNw5-R8RZ_hLyzFthKUrZw9UchICwDCggznPCaxNzIMYZM1EVfYZTtwpKNj50h7kHeU2cgF-roWhWOGc3Cq1ucWxbyMxgv9OYbZbYaRHwIublSPBcW2mqYShKPA5R8trgp5QVP20qPBnCmhoqd0w0FAxBATz_EA==&c=eZvZjqdag9DPrihbrp6wT58N-6_nwW_Wuq9iiH7bBU1AoqSq-jf88A==&ch=sEIcbi-d2obHu7C8bmS6gQjQpMOKO6ZOxzivL9WNGBK2wfm2QvVEbg==)

Peter,
For decades, Democrats have played by the rules while Republicans ruthlessly gerrymandered their way to power.
We took the high road. We preached about norms and precedent. We talked about "when they go low, we go high."
And where did that get us?
A rigged system where Republicans can lose the popular vote by millions and still control Congress. A democracy where the will of the people is crushed under the weight of partisan maps drawn in backrooms by MAGA operatives.
Well, that era just ended.
Democrats across the country are done being punching bags! California unleashed Proposition 50. New York, Virginia, and Maryland are redrawing their maps.
The "nuclear option" has been deployed and there's no going back.
But here's the brutal reality: Democrats cannot unilaterally surrender while Republicans are rigging the game in Texas, North Carolina, Missouri, Florida, and Indiana.
If we don't use every single card in the book while MAGA ramps up their attacks, we guarantee that Democrats will never retake the House. Not in 2026. Not in 2028. Not for a generation.
Trump would have unchecked power to invade countries, dismantle the Federal Reserve, prosecute his enemies, and turn America into an authoritarian nightmare--and there wouldn't be a damn thing we could do to stop him.
That's not an option.
Coloradans are committed to fighting back tooth and nail, because the time for rolling over in the Trump-era is DONE.
This is why Colorado Draws the Line is spearheading the ballot initiative that will erase 3 to 4 GOP seats off the Colorado map and stop Trump's election rigging scheme dead in its tracks. We're not apologizing for it. We're not ashamed of it. And we're sure as hell not backing down.
MAGA wants a fight? They've got one.
[Will you rush $50, $30, $15, or whatever you can spare to help Colorado join the Democratic counteroffensive and fight fire with fire? We either fight back NOW or we surrender our democracy forever.](https://6s79z9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001RRKh1e2MaVR4TzXPSiBVY159FbB_ycv5oexFsKBGqjGiaYUV8dVJ3WLQNw5-R8RZ96reCFBoElg20x3LzXPoHuIyAfgXamDCO-a-2yHsnIIInvx61YmEPue9sTqwVpZNWbSUjHMo6dEQhyatkypDHwLQNWO5zk20XTSFoR2YoDwyepqkBfLnaYYL6eHSIEmq66F7VZPL9tPhDVdcM8gboo2Ph6xlX-TC&c=eZvZjqdag9DPrihbrp6wT58N-6_nwW_Wuq9iiH7bBU1AoqSq-jf88A==&ch=sEIcbi-d2obHu7C8bmS6gQjQpMOKO6ZOxzivL9WNGBK2wfm2QvVEbg==)

Peter,

In his latest interview, Donald Trump was asked a question about Republican performance across the country. Polls show the GOP agenda in a negative light. Tight House races are leaning closer and closer towards Democrats. And what did he have to say about it all?: _**"When you think of it, we shouldn't even have an election."**_
We wish this were the worst of it. But Trump continued his anti-democracy plays by directing his attorney general to demand access to Minnesota voter rolls—treating Americans' voting information like a bargaining chip. And to top it all off, at the World Economic Forum in Davos, _he openly talked about prosecuting people for the results of the 2020 election–results he still claims are rigged._

These aren't slips of the tongue; **they're a pattern.**

Trump is saying the quiet part out loud: **he doesn't want the American people to be able to hold him accountable. Trump wants power, Peter.** He wants a government centered around himself. And too many Republicans in Congress— _and even the Supreme Court_ —are willing to help him get there.

From rigging congressional maps in their favor, attacking vote-by-mail, and even going so far as to stand with Trump and his claims to run for a third presidential term, Republicans will stop at nothing to ensure they win another two years of power and cling to their razor-thin House majority.

We have to put an end to it NOW.

We'll say it again: anyone who has to rig races in their favor to win shouldn't be in office in the first place. And anyone who cares more about holding power than helping the American people doesn't deserve to set foot back in Congress. That's why we don't just need to hold Republicans accountable for their actions–we have to remove them from office for good.

| Peter, I released my annual financial disclosure form, and it only took me 5 minutes – because I don’t own any stocks.

And that’s exactly what Republicans love attacking me for: not being rich.

They can attack me all they want, but I have _no_ shame. Unlike them, I haven’t abused my office to get rich off stock trading.

When I ran for Congress, I drove for Uber and took on credit card debt just to get by. And after my swearing in, I got denied from apartments in D.C. because of my credit.

So it’s funny when I get called out for experiencing the struggles that working class Americans experience everyday – because shouldn’t we have more leaders who know what it’s like? I think if we did, Congress would work a lot better than it does now.

I’m proud to represent us, and I’m committed to fighting for all of us. But it wasn’t easy for someone like me to get to Congress, so I need your support to stay here. ---
| | Friend,
---
| | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn’t a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal — the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God’s grace.**

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**“God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.”**_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.
---
[](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9p2nm&__onlt=h)
---
When you read it, you will hear Charlie’s voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family.

Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

**[To claim your copy of this life-changing book, simply make a generous gift in any amount to Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9p2nm&__onlt=h)**

---
In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans...

...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — _**it’s the message of FAITH!**_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. _And it’s happening._

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we’re witnessing is not just growth —**it’s revival.**

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families.

We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message.

You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie.

**But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up.**

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, _“We’re not backing down.”_

This is what Charlie prayed for.

I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too.

None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, **_so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith._**

Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God.

**[To claim your copy of Charlie’s final book, simply make a gift, in any amount, to support Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9p2nm&__onlt=h)**

---
I’ll personally ensure your copy is sent to you as soon as possible.

Thank you in advance for carrying on Charlie’s mission and supporting his legacy.
---

**Justin Streiff**
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point USA

* * *
_Friday, January 30, 2026_
Dear Substack,
The Trump Administration is the most lawless, corrupt, cruel, and anti-constitutional in American history. That Trump ran as a convicted felon should have been a warning.
Yet they have crossed a new Rubicon. Today, they arrested former CNN anchor Don Lemon, independent journalist Georgia Fort, community organizer Traheen Jean Crews, and Minnesota state senate candidate Jamael Lydell Lundy. Their stated justification? These four entered a church to protest a pastor who collaborates with ICE.
This is an affront to our system of government--and it is no coincidence that all four work to expose Trump's serial malfeasance, organize voters against him, or campaign for office as members of the opposition. This is Putinesque: a strategy to eliminate political opponents so Trump's party can win in November, despite his deep unpopularity with the American public.
To make matters worse, Attorney General Pam Bondi and those who carried out these arrests appear to have done so in direct defiance of two separate court orders. This is not law enforcement--it is an attack on participatory democracy itself.
This came just one day after it was revealed that Bondi told the Minnesota Secretary of State that ICE would withdraw only if he turned over private voter data. This is the same Donald Trump whom Special Counsel Jack Smith described as "most responsible" for the January 6th attack on the Capitol--and who was recorded pressuring Georgia officials to "find" him 12,000 votes.
Is there anyone who can't see what is going on here?
Make no mistake: they do not intend to permit fair elections in November. Whether through arrests of political opponents, the closure of polling places, voter intimidation, or purging registration rolls, this is a dress rehearsal.
This is one of those moments in history that Ronald Reagan once called "a time for choosing." Everyone must decide where they stand--with democracy or with Trump's autocracy. There is no third option.
We call on creators, journalists, and public officials to act _now_. Attorneys general, district attorneys, and governors must use every lawful power at their disposal to block illegal federal actions and protect civilians from political repression.
If you do not, it is only a matter of time before these same masked agents turn their attention to you. Deep down, you know this.
Act now if you value the First Amendment, pluralism, and a free United States of America. Prove worthy of the sacred trust your citizens placed in you. You may not get another chance.
Sincerely,
Clifford D. Schecter
Founder/CEO Blue Amp Media

Peter,

This past Sunday's Resistance Lab was incredible — and a clear reminder of
the collective power we can build together.

More than 3,000 people joined us for our 13th Resistance Lab, making it
one of our biggest yet. And if that wasn't inspiring enough,we just
[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/52449?t=1002&akid=5862%2E420207%2Eug7uCQ ]PASSED a resolution at the King County Council calling on Congress to

accountability, such as ending for-profit detention, and protecting our

grateful for these sessions and the opportunity to connect with our

Anne, from California

Renee Good and Alex Pretti, who were brutalized and killed in Minneapolis
under ICE's reign of terror. Their deaths are part of an unprecedented
level of chaos and cruelty that demands action.

Minnesota and how we resist Trump's dangerous authoritarian agenda with
courage, care, and our collective power. We focused on turning our anger,
grief, and apathy into action — because authoritarianism can only be
defeated by the strength of our people-powered movements.

We also discussed the Backfire Model, which is designed to, as Pramila
stated, "make the violent actions of an authoritarian regime 'backfire' on
themselves." It's guided by the Five R's, which intensify public pressure

subject: We can’t let them win
body:
Peter,
I wanted to emphasize just how serious of a moment we are in.
Donald Trump’s federal agents are going door to door in Minnesota looking for folks based on their accent or color of their skin. Kids are afraid to go to school, small businesses are hurting, another life has been lost, and the people responsible have yet to be held accountable. Instead, Donald Trump’s DOJ is investigating me.
Why? Because my focus has always been protecting the people of Minnesota.
They’re trying to scare me and our state — but Minnesota will not be intimidated into silence and neither will I. This legal battle will be expensive, that’s why they’re doing this. They want me to back down and surrender, but I won’t.

Friend, it's Heidi Hall, and this race for Congress is far from over.
This month we were able to successfully stop the automatic endorsement process that would've allowed a candidate that doesn't even live in our district to be given institutional support for no reason other than already being in office.
Our district deserves a leader who understands that we need both a progressive problem solver that will fight for Medicare for All, to protect our environment, and support working families, and someone who understands our rural and suburban communities.
Friend, I moved to Grass Valley to raise my two boys as a single mom, and I know so many in our community with similar stories.
I understand constantly thinking about kitchen table issues like being able to pay rent, buy groceries, and get healthcare because I lived that.
Other candidates in this race can't say the same.
That's why I'm running for Congress—to unseat Trump's rubber stamp, Kevin Kiley, and actually fight to help the people of our district. Will you join me by donating what you can to help us raise $7,145 before our first End of Month Deadline of the year? We can't fall short now. Raised by parents who had persisted to make a middle-class life for their kids in Contra Costa County while lifting up others, Heidi was taught to push through and overcome challenges rather than complain about them. She learned to stick up for the vulnerable, to respect working people, and to value equal opportunity and justice.
After graduating from Pomona College and earning graduate degrees from Columbia and Rutgers, Heidi went to work for the Rockefeller Foundation promoting reproductive care and then began her career at the Environmental Protection Agency, stopping the dumping of toxic waste and holding corporate polluters accountable.

Colorado’s quiet revival: A custody provision lawmakers stripped is back in SB26-018
| | | | [](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
| | Hi friends,
Listen to today's Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.joinrmv.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.joinrmv.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.joinrmv.). Here is a summary of today's top stories:
**🏛️ Under the Golden Dome...** [Rapid Medicaid growth](https://link.email.joinrmv.) is crowding out other priorities with little interest in reform, while HB26-1030 would [force data centers to rely on unreliable energy sources](https://link.email.joinrmv.)—threatening grid stability and investment. Meanwhile, SB26-018 [revives controversial custody language tied to gender identity](https://link.email.joinrmv.), reigniting fears of government intrusion into family decisions.
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Tensions are rising across the state as Denver joins a[ legal challenge against expanded federal immigration enforcemen](https://link.email.joinrmv.)t, a move critics say undermines cooperation with law enforcement. At the same time, sheriffs and prosecutors are [backing Michael Allen for attorney general](https://link.email.joinrmv.), citing his courtroom experience and crime-reduction record. In education, the Cherry Creek [superintendent’s resignation](https://link.email.joinrmv.) amid toxic-culture reports has renewed accountability concerns, while expiring property tax relief is hitting homeowners with [increases of 20 to 40 percent](https://link.email.joinrmv.).
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** House lawmakers are investigating allegations that wealthy foreign nationals [bypassed Americans on organ transplant waiting lists](https://link.email.joinrmv.), raising serious questions about fairness and accountability at tax-exempt hospitals. Separately, [far-left activist groups tied to a CCP-linked financier](https://link.email.joinrmv.) are pushing a nationwide anti-ICE shutdown, calling for Americans to stop work, school, and commerce—an effort critics warn could further destabilize public order.
**🗣️ Commentary Spotlight...** Today’s commentary examines accountability under pressure, from [scrutiny of Aurora City Councilman Rob Andrews’](https://link.email.joinrmv.) leadership claims amid ethical and legal concerns, to a broader analysis of [election integrity battles](https://link.email.joinrmv.) that shows how prolonged litigation can punish dissent long before the truth is ever fully settled.
This is your Mountain Minute for Friday, January 30, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Colorado’s quiet revival: A custody provision lawmakers stripped is back in SB26-018](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
When Colorado lawmakers removed custody language from a transgender-related bill in 2025, the fight appeared to cool — or at least move out of view. It didn’t last.
Jan. 14 marked the formal introduction of Senate Bill 26-018, backed in the Senate by Katie Wallace and Chris Kolker and carried in the House by Meg Froelich and Lorena García. No Republicans signed on.
The bill was assigned to Senate Judiciary, chaired by sponsor Chris Kolker. Lead sponsor Katie Wallace has emphasized education and family policy in discussing the measure, drawing on her background on the Jefferson County School Board.
The proposal revives a custody standard lawmakers stripped from a similar bill last session after public opposition. In earlier hearings, parents and family law attorneys warned the language would shift custody decisions away from a child’s best interests. The revised version returns that concept in narrower terms, embedded deeper in statute. For some Colorado families, the issue is anything but theoretical.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
**[Joe Oltmann, Erik Coomer, and the War Over Reality](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY C. J. GARBO, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* ******Election integrity dissent meets relentless legal warfare:** Joe Oltmann became a central figure in post-2020 election disputes after amplifying claims involving former Dominion employee Erik Coomer, triggering years of subpoenas, court orders, and crushing legal costs before any final resolution of truth.

* **The punishment is the process, not just the verdict:** The article argues modern defamation litigation is increasingly used to exhaust, financially ruin, and silence dissenters, noting a federal appeals court affirmed contempt sanctions against Oltmann tied to Coomer-related disputes.

* **A warning about speech, discipline, and institutional power:** Whether one views Oltmann as right or wrong, the case illustrates how challenging entrenched narratives can invite overwhelming legal consequences, reinforcing the need for precision, evidence, and restraint in public claims.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|

[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
|
---
**[Denver Enters Court Fight Over Federal Immigration Enforcement](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **Denver sides against federal immigration enforcement:** The city has joined dozens of jurisdictions in filing an amicus brief backing Minnesota’s lawsuit to halt expanded ICE operations, arguing federal enforcement is punitive rather than necessary.
* **City leaders frame ICE presence as unconstitutional overreach:** Denver’s filing claims increased federal enforcement violates the 10th Amendment, despite ICE operating under federal authority to enforce immigration law.
* **Critics warn the move undermines public safety and rule of law:** Opponents argue Denver is prioritizing political resistance over cooperation with federal agencies tasked with enforcing existing immigration laws.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
[**Who is Rob Andrews? Questions grow around leadership, accountability and public trust**](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[****](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**BY MICHAEL HANCOCK | COMMENTARY | JANUARY 29** _Every election season, voters are introduced to a carefully curated version of the candidates seeking their trust. Titles are polished. Résumés are condensed. Claims are simplified into slogans. And too often, no one pauses to ask whether the story being told actually matches the public record. Think George Santos, the former New York Republican who was expelled from Congress for fabricating his background and misusing funds._
__
[**Sheriffs and prosecutors rally behind Michael Allen for attorney general, cite courtroom experience**](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[****](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**BY SHAINA COLE | STATE | JANUARY 29** _A handful of sheriffs and district attorneys from different parts of the state have come out in support of Fourth Judicial District Attorney Michael Allen, today, as he campaigns for Colorado attorney general. The endorsements focus on his years spent in actual courtrooms prosecuting cases and the way he’s managed to cut back on some crimes in his district._
__
[**Inside the Assessor’s Office: Why Greg Ketcham Is Running for Jefferson County Assessor**](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[****](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**BY SHAINA COLE | LOCAL | JANUARY 28** _For most Jefferson County residents, the assessor’s office only becomes visible when a valuation notice arrives in the mail. For Greg Ketcham, the office has been his professional home for more than eight years — and it’s the reason he decided to run for Jefferson County Assessor._
__

## Dad Sees Color for the First Time
A South Carolina father was brought to tears after [seeing color for the first time](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO4yAURb8Gd0T4mdi4oNjGXbbdEmF4GHawieBNrPz9yPmFqc_V0b3338M8bMrp2P7aHXXYgqFQzIFny0iE1XjrG2JzJZcaC7lYXMmWMBoQMHLR80EYb1N-G9l5HRABhw51P42zEuMsVRe1WoOSo3WrDHa1IUA_KSUkzG5WKN29S_qyiX4Q0AsAuE3DcJ_VKnpA73C-MynQJyr19r-kgyKG_C4vrDdX9i7rSPRsbPjDYGGw-NTcB7bzaFeCwXL5GSyiv7j1fK1ovxr35Ty4DYSVN8R0bPxa-l0bD6VyishDqo04pR0ZLF3V_nmmnFMbJybFttuUPx3o1-e9NPwEAAD__-CbhXA), thanks to a special pair of glasses gifted by his son. Jim Gogan, 61, had lived his whole life colorblind, a condition that cost him a shot at becoming an Air Force pilot decades ago. His son Kyle, 39, had talked for years about getting him colorblind glasses and finally made it happen this Christmas with help from a work bonus. [A family video](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFu6yAUxvGnwVssfCC2GRjubZWlTbe2I8KcQ6AiIbJPYrlPX6Wv0PX7pN_w_zy6o88lX05v_kw2nqLjWN2F1qUQM80OPS5ES6ilzqlySDXU4pmSAwn9TnY7JR36XDanG7SRCEg1ZLuhN6PsjR6bZIPxBkeMU9BhUgi90UYpxDjooYcQm2wfmuyUhE4CQDsotTfjJDsgDGT2QkvCzHVuv2q-cKJYtnqnuQ313BSbmK-LUP8EHAQc1nVtt3rj20SP_7F4Dkmow12o51f4_r-9vH88qWMzW7yuuZS89IPQ8nT2ufyS_OcWdws_AQAA__9VWHQ-) shows Jim overcome with emotion after putting on the glasses and taking in the Christmas lights. The first color that floored him? Red. The next day, the family took him on a drive to enjoy the outdoors in full color for the very first time, a moment years in the making.
## Nebraska Grandma’s Porch Crock Sells for $32K
A 91-year-old Nebraska woman got a birthday surprise she’ll never forget when a rare stoneware crock that sat on her porch for decades [sold at auction for $32,000](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O4yAUhZ8Gd0Rw8W9BsY27bLslwnAJbLBvBEwiv_3I8wpTn6NP53z_7uZuU07H46_dUYdHMC2QOfBTM7aGxXjrK2J1lKlEai6So2wbRgMCRi4kV8J4m_Jp-s7rgAioOtRyGpdZjEs_d1Ev0zQ710th-20eQC2zCDa4QagN-9FuXdIXTUglQAoAuE1KDcu8CQnoHS4D6wX61Kjc_lM6WsSQT3pjuTnau6xja6_K1B8GK4P1OF9U2xUxWC8wg1VIBqscGKxflV__rh5uxdan5R_a7VF5sQW5K-SevGLOlQcqXMGT08EjFr7I2viWSovengzWrmj_-qScUx0n1ovHblP-WdR-rfKt4TsAAP__rRyIPg). Lois Jurgens had nearly given it away at a garage sale, thinking it was worth maybe $50. But [a local auctioneer](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO4jAYhJ8m6YhsJ3GcwgUcF10B6A4JcbtN5MS_icGOITZ4w9Ov2H2EraYZzXz6jtt2K7TR42knLHB1Um1Qrh0hegMhwNRKIT2A751x0-BCP7jeGRFgaAkidIHwIketFNrMbZFKrgAI5ClwXNGaIVoXLB04FRR3BaU1sDKXTKAKEKv7GlUgJaMi1fy1hnCOCEaEkKzK87JmHcIEZA91mRQIpA5uys5Oj2EAZWb3gCnrnU0NH0K4-iRfJqRJSBNjzJTooXPu8iokpPnljAEYj9oYLaz_O4GHMfiENFfnv1N1WiIi9v-e9r84nC-Fva8Uffr4YfEdH250WVYHO95cZOuZ3FZNo5arP-Htt97tIw6b9eb8rmaTTlxe4-vH0yop0MkKbb4ww4_9Pjj5DAAA__9O0ZJ2) spotted rare double stamps and blue butterfly markings from Red Wing Stoneware, turning it into a collector’s prize. The bidding war drew buyers from Texas, Kansas, and Iowa. Jurgens missed the auction [while volunteering at church](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD3O5CAQRE9jZ1gN_g8INnE2m25oYWgMO4zbgtZYvv1qRtoTfHlVqd7781gfJqZ47L_NC7Xf_cqe1gOvkpAZ8-qMK4jFUqIciG0gS8kwhlWBGgRI0cLqTEz32tVOe0SFbY1ajsM8wTB3Ux20G2YzIKqt9yg9yG0eO4RBzjD1o-mhjvqzBrIFJUEp1Yxt28_TBlKhszj3VQfoIlNu_lI8OKBPN70xN5ZeddKB-SxV-6tSS6WW67qanch9MA7ki_KzobxXarGZ7FOUyByPXdAhAmZxUrZBeMqiA3GjyUV4ZBuwiFY9hfGMWZSAItCJ7huUAP_bW8wcnLkrtdRZu_OKKcUyjFUH-8vE9H3IP1b71upfAAAA__-mv5C6), but when she heard the final price, she nearly buckled at the knees. | | Friend,

I am a survivor of child trafficking--and today, I work to make sure other children never face what I did. My name is Theresa Flores. **I was fifteen years old.****An honor student.
****A daughter.

body:
| Peter,

Our community thrives because we stand up for each other — especially when times are difficult. Recently, I issued a statement about troubling reports that **Afghan refugees in Sacramento County — many of whom stood side‐by‐side with our troops — have been the target of ICE operations in our community.** This is deeply concerning and strikes at the heart of who we are as a nation.

Sacramento is home to _one of the largest Afghan communities in the country_ , and these families have contributed to our economy, our culture, and our shared sense of belonging. Many worked directly with our troops in Afghanistan and fled persecution, trusting America to uphold its commitments.

In my statement, I made it clear:
* These families deserve **full due process and humane treatment** under our laws.
* We cannot let the actions of _one individual_ tarnish an entire community.
* My office will continue working tirelessly to ensure these refugees are **treated fairly and with dignity.**

This moment reminds us why this campaign matters — **to protect our values, defend our neighbors, and build a Sacramento where everyone is treated with dignity and respect.**

We have 51% support, but it’s going to be tight.
# [](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/131?refcode=em20260130-99&t=1&akid=99%2E12592%2EWgfiIK)
A poll was just released that shows **51% support** among Virginians for the constitutional amendment that would allow mid-cycle redistricting ahead of this year’s midterm elections.
**We’re within reach of a BIG win that truly matters for Virginians.**
[**Help us solidify support for a YES vote by donating $25 or more today!**](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260130_1.aFiTt8&amount=25&refcode=20260130-99&t=2&akid=99%2E12592%2EWgfiIK)
We’re not the only people watching these polling results closely. Right-wing pundits and activists are tracking these numbers, too.
Republicans know they’re losing, and in the weeks ahead they’re going to flood Virginia with misinformation to confuse voters and drown out the truth about this amendment. They’re already attempting to slow down our progress with their court-shopped ruling handed down earlier this week. And with a margin this close, we have to stay on guard.
[**More partisan political games are incoming from MAGA Republicans. Can you help us fight back and keep our edge by donating****$25 today?**](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260130_1.aFiTt8&amount=25&refcode=20260130-99&t=3&akid=99%2E12592%2EWgfiIK)
**[Donate $25 ››](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260130_1.aFiTt8&amount=25&refcode=20260130-99&t=22&akid=99%2E12592%2EWgfiIK)**
We urgently need resources to cut through the noise and make sure voters know that voting YES will protect their representation and level the playing field nationwide. That’s why your support right now matters so much.
This vote is going to be close. Every conversation at the doors, every ad, and yes — every dollar raised — will make a difference.
[**Chip in today to help us prepare to fend off incoming right-wing attacks and keep up the momentum for a YES vote.**](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260130_1.aFiTt8&amount=25&refcode=20260130-99&t=23&akid=99%2E12592%2EWgfiIK)
Together, we can secure fair elections and protect the right of Virginians to have a real say in their democracy.

clean_body: We have 51% support, but it’s going to be tight. A poll was just released that shows 51% support among Virginians for the constitutional amendment that would allow mid-cycle redistricting ahead of this year’s midterm elections. We’re within reach of a BIG win that truly matters for Virginians. We’re not the only people watching these polling results closely. Right-wing pundits and activists are tracking these numbers, too. Republicans know they’re losing, and in the weeks ahead they’re going to flood Virginia with misinformation to confuse voters and drown out the truth about this amendment. They’re already attempting to slow down our progress with their court-shopped ruling handed down earlier this week. And with a margin this close, we have to stay on guard. We urgently need resources to cut through the noise and make sure voters know that voting YES will protect their representation and level the playing field nationwide. That’s why your support right now matters so much. This vote is going to be close. Every conversation at the doors, every ad, and yes — every dollar raised — will make a difference. Together, we can secure fair elections and protect the right of Virginians to have a real say in their democracy. Thank you for being part of this fight, Virginians For Fair Elections

The fight for our immigrant communities doesn’t stop here. We need our elected officials to pass laws that protect all people from state-sanctioned violence; ensures families and their loved ones are safe from abduction; protects our right to free speech and assembly; and defends our democracy from fascism. We are proud to support Philadelphia City Councilmembers Kendra Brooks and Rue Landau’s proposed “ICE OUT” legislative package. [https://phlcouncil.com/philadelphia-elected-leaders-introduce-ice-out-legislative-package-to-protect-immigrant-communities/] THIS is what a government that cares for people looks like - actively listening to community members, involving people in the process, and taking tangible and actionable steps to protect our loved ones..

API PA at Philadelphia City Hall
API PA is doing the work to organize Asian communities across Pennsylvania to win this long-term vision. Our members are driving the movement to keep our communities strong in the shadow of the Trump administration.
[https://secure.everyaction.com/npIH-E4iR0aHxi8U2uZ5kQ2?contactdata=i2EO7Ts9bLcUuyUCvZ98Mko4jZVQp0pDaihkUF8Jc56uK86ZNOAE7u/IeFEdaDucZg806b4g+1DykMGNH4kxJHaFk27+D04FKsedFkzeVG8wYLSl3QZ0qcBaCRqTRZCoggAFHWy4Ufmyd3JirJ5mQGmT569y/cRlO1Q/Pmw4moI=]

“I’m the proud daughter of Taiwanese immigrants who grew up under martial law — where scholars were silenced, families separated, activists kidnapped and detained, and language suppressed — who came to this country searching for freedom and a future.
They had my oldest brother at a hospital in St. Paul — just twenty minutes from South Minneapolis, where Renee Good and Alex Pettri were killed during ICE operations this month. Where ICE agents are reportedly asking people to rat out their Asian neighbors.
I’m proud to be part of a pan-racial community here in Pennsylvania that last year stood up to corporate interests and corrupt politicians and said: NO ARENA IN CHINATOWN.
That community — our community — doesn’t mess around.
And we don’t forget.”

Peter,
I’ve spent the last week listening to people in Minneapolis who are living in fear of masked federal agents stalking their neighborhoods.
And I’m furious at what’s happening in Washington.
After the killing of Renée Good and Alex Pretti and the siege of Minneapolis, Senate Democratic leadership is preparing to fold.
Under pressure from the White House, Chuck Schumer is signaling that Senate Democrats will accept a weak DHS funding deal that keeps ICE and CBP fully operational, fully funded, and fully unaccountable.
Let me be clear: Congress has the power to stop this. Democrats must do everything they can to restore and defend the rule of law. That’s why Carlos Eduardo Espina and I are rolling out a 10-point plan to hold ICE accountable and reform immigration enforcement:
✅ Vote no on the DHS funding bill.
✅ Repeal the multi-year $75 billion funding for ICE.
✅ Impeach Noem and Bondi.
✅ End qualified immunity for ICE agents.
✅ Investigate and prosecute every single ICE agent who broke the law.
✅ End the Kavanaugh stops with racial profiling and the militarization of ICE.
✅ Codify a use-of-force standard so courts can enforce the law against rogue ICE agents.
✅ Tear down and replace ICE with an agency that has oversight.
✅ Prohibit masks and mandate body cameras and visible identification for immigration officers.
✅ Establish human rights standards at immigration detention facilities.

I refuse to play along with performative opposition while Trump turns federal agencies into a standing army. That’s why I’m demanding Democrats vote NO on DHS funding until real reforms are secured.
👉 ADD YOUR NAME: Tell Senate Democrats to stop folding and actually rein in ICE. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/ice-reform-plan-petition?contactdata=V0+hETMw5izHZ31UbykS9fkxmucQaznXIW0mbqS1TNAbfI75dQtX4fvoebDHWtUxA00Zya01uKQR0KO/uBYartmNFJQ3pf6pm3t0RFvKMlUK9m3vhn54iwBEc0t0KcgO+ea660fszxzc2CYTWzDYi+xii7rO126NhNEk7BQg6E2kz0mNEOqPlVqi9OPp3sBo]
If another newly hired ICE or CBP agent kills someone in Chicago, Denver, or Minneapolis, a body camera won’t bring them back — and it won’t guarantee justice.
We can’t wait until 2027 to stop the invasion of American cities. The time to fight is now.
In solidarity,
Ro

name: Derek Kitchen
subject: I'm running for Congress in Utah.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kitchen for Utah
body:
Utah raised me. It shaped me. And it’s the place where I have fought – sometimes against long odds – to make life fairer, more welcoming, and more hopeful for all of us.
---
| | [ ](https://dk4ut.com/l/kSTq9kO6fg6X)
---
Peter, I have some big news to share! I’m running for Congress in Utah’s newly drawn 1st Congressional District. Utah raised me. It shaped me. And it’s the place where I have fought – sometimes against long odds – to make life fairer, more welcoming, and more hopeful for all of us. **[Today, I’m asking you to join me in the fight for Utah. Can you please be one of the first people to chip in to my campaign by making a donation of $10, $20, or whatever makes sense to you?](https://dk4ut.com/l/1F14y9CH1ADR)**
---
[ **Chip in »** ](https://dk4ut.com/l/0g8VzYyiFitu)
---
Many of you first met me in 2013, when I sued the state of Utah for the right to get married. _Kitchen v. Herbert_ made Utah the first state in the nation where a federal court required recognition of same-sex marriage, helping lay the groundwork for marriage equality nationwide. That fight was about courage, dignity, and believing that Utah could lead. Since then, I’ve served on the Salt Lake City Council and in the Utah State Senate, where I worked every day to make our state more affordable, more just, and more inclusive. I’ve led the progressive fight for housing, economic development that benefits working families, and smart growth in a valley that’s changing faster than ever. And throughout it all, I’ve stood proudly with organized labor - working with Democrats to move bold ideas forward and with Republicans wherever we can agree. [**I’m ready to help move Utah forward, but I need your help. Can you chip in to support my campaign today?**](https://dk4ut.com/l/QdDJML2k9Yig)
---
[ **Chip in »** ](https://dk4ut.com/l/8dvRTompV9qx)
---
I’ve been proud to serve in government, but many of my biggest lessons come from the small business that I own. For over a decade, I’ve run a small restaurant here in Salt Lake. It isn’t glamorous – I have to juggle payroll, scrubbing down at midnight, and hoping the dishwasher doesn’t break. But it’s taught me what leadership looks like up close: you take care of your people, you pay a living wage because it’s the right thing to do, and you build community, one meal at a time. These experiences – fighting for equality, serving in public office, and keeping a small business alive – are why I’m running for Congress now. For the first time in generations, Utah has a solidly Democratic congressional district. A district that can elect a progressive champion who doesn’t shy away from tough fights, doesn’t water down our values, and doesn’t vote against fundamental rights. And that’s big. We have a real choice in this race. We can send someone to Congress who plays it safe, or we can send someone who has spent his entire life fighting for justice, equality, and a better future for Utah families. [**I’m ready to bring our progressive voice to represent Utah in Congress. But I can’t do it alone. This campaign will be powered by grassroots supporters from day one. Can you make one of the very first donations to our campaign today?**](https://dk4ut.com/l/bo4Ssbnk0S3P)
---

I believe in the Utah that raised me – the one that looks out for neighbors, builds community from the ground up, and isn’t afraid to lead. That’s what this campaign is about. And with your support, we can win this race and bring bold, principled leadership to Washington. Thank you for believing in a more progressive Utah. More from me soon. Derek Kitchen
Candidate for Congress (UT-01)
